text: A sẽn yeel woto wã,

text: pʋg-yãangã yikame n bao nangur n kõ-a.

text: A sẽn wãb n sa tɩ kaoos bilfu,

title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: T’a Yamne leoke:
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: - Yaa m pʋg n pa pid la m ket n pa gõe.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Yiri,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: b kõta maam bĩisim,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: tɩ mam yũ n yaool n gũsi.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A Yamne sẽn yeel woto,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: pʋg-yaanga yikame n tɩ bao bĩis-naare,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n wa kõ-a,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: la a gõgnemde:
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: - Ya n yaa bõe sɩ-lak biig la woto,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n tõt gõeem?
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pʋg-yãangã ne biigã kell n talla woto,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: hal tɩ zĩigã wa zʋʋge.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A Yamne wa n yeel-a lame tɩ yẽ rata kamaan-maasa.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pʋg-yãangã sɩd yiime,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n na n tɩ bao kamaanã.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Sasa-kãng la a nek a kẽem-dããmbã tɩ b teem zĩiga.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Bãmb tɩ gãanda pʋg-yãangã kamb sẽn da gãeẽ wã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n yaool n tall pʋg-yãangã kamb n wa gãneg bãmb zĩige wã.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A Yamne sẽn bãng t’a maan woto,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: a reega kamaanã n wãbe,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: la a gũsi.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pʋg-yãan-sõyã sẽn paam t’a Yamne gũsã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: a yikame n saas a sʋʋgã.,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n kood kãmb a naasã.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Sẽn ya likã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: a pa bãng tɩ yaa yẽ meng kambã la a sẽn koodã ye.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A ra teedame tɩ yaa kom-pugli wã.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A Yamne sẽn bãng tɩ beoogã kolg veegre,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: a neka a kẽem-dãmbã tɩ b sãd n looge.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Beoogã sẽn vẽeg zãngã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: la pʋg-yãangã yaool n bãng tɩ yaa a meng kambã la a sẽn kood ne yʋngã.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A sũurã yikame,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: t’a yi n na n dig kom-pugli wã.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Kambã me yõka zoees ne weoogã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: tɩ b na paam n põse.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: La b wa n yãame tɩ sõyã na n paam-b lame tɩ b kabl n paam n dʋ toɛɛga.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pʋg-yãangã yaool n da tara bendre.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A taa toɛɛgã tẽngre,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n wẽed a bendrã woto:
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pimpindim pindim-pindim,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: bi-pugl-poll yãk n lʋɩ tɩ m dɩk n kõ m kamba,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: pidgim pindim.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A sẽn wẽ a bendrã woto,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: la bi-pugl a ye sẽn yi yĩngrã n farg n lʋɩ.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: T’a rɩk yẽ n dɩglg kɩrenga,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n le wẽ yɛsa:
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pimpindim pindim-pindim.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A talla Woto,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: tɩ kom-pugli a tãabã luɩ,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n kell a Yamne.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A sã n yɩɩnde la a pãbd bendrã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: la a Yamne sẽn kuiis toɛɛgã yĩngr n paasde.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A talla woto n wa mik t’a ka na n paam-a ye,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: t’a maneg n fo a kalle,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n na n dʋ tɩɩgã n babs-a.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A Yamne basame tɩ pʋg-yãan-sõya ta toɛɛgã yĩngri,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: t’a yɩ tao-tao n sigi,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n dɩk a bendrã n wẽ woto:
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Pimpindim pindim-pindim,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: pʋg-yãan-wɛɛg yãk n lʋɩ tɩ m dɩk n kõ m kẽem-dãmba,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: pidgim pindim.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A sẽn wẽ bendrã woto wã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: la pʋg-yãangã sẽn sɩng lʋɩɩse,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n tek n yagle.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: T’a le wẽ,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: t’a le farg n kolg noorẽ,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n le tek n yagle.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: T’a le wẽ yɛsa,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: tɩ pʋg-yãangã vũ n wa tẽng bup!
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: A sẽn lʋɩ wã,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: a kiime.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: Yɩɩ woto t’a Yamne ne a kẽem-dãmbã na n paam n põse,
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: n lebg n wa yiri.
title: 1 A Yamne kibare

text: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo.

title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: b ra tũuda taab n kẽnd la b sõsda.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: B wa n yãa korg sẽn dɩg bãmb taoorã.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: B sẽn dɩk n lakã,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: b yãame tɩ ligd wʋsg n da be be.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Tao bala,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: a Sĩndbal yeelame:
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: - Ligd wã fãa!
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Ad tõnd zug nooma.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: T’a Ratzãng wẽneg n sok-a :
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: - Bõe?
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Mam zug noom bɩ tõnd zug nooma ?
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Ãnd n yã korgã n dɩke?
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: La a Sĩndbal pa bao n na n kɩɩs ye.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: A kell n sĩnda a noor bala.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: B sẽn gom korgã yell n sa,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: b kell n tara sõasg bal la b tutẽ.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Sẽn kaoos bilfu,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: b wʋma bʋʋr sẽn tʋk poorẽ wã.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Neb n da rigd wagdre.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: B sẽn yã a Ratzãng ne a Sĩndbalã,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: b yõk-b lame,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: n vaees b futã,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: n yã korgã ne ligdã.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Mik yaa wagdr n sɩd da zuk korgã,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: tɩ b sẽn digd-a wã t’a lobg la a zoe.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Wã masã la Ratzãng yeel yã:
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: - Ad yell paam tõndo!
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: T’a Sĩndbal sok-a:
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: - Yell paam tõndo?

text: Ãnda?
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Yell paam foo kae.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Pa foo n dɩk korgã la?
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Mam toog be be?
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: Nebã pema a Ratzãng n tall-a n kẽng na-yiri,
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: n yaool n bas a Sĩndbal tɩ yẽ loog a loogre.
title: 2 Yã ligd n yĩm zoodo

text: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tẽng a ye n da tar a naaba,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: tɩ nebã fãa nong-a.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Naabã me ra rɩta naamã ne zemsgo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Wẽnnaam me sɩd da ning-a-la barka:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: pagba,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a tara,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: kamba,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a tara Bark kamba.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: N-ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Bark kamba,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la ka b fãa ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A ye n da ya bi-tõtre.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rẽ me,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a le ya sũ-ki-neda.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Ned sã n paam bũmbu,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: zabd-a lame.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La bũmb ning sẽn wa n tɩ zabd-a n yɩɩda,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yaa tɩ b ba wã kũum poore,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: naamã na n põsg-a lame.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rẽ yaa vẽenega,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yẽ sẽn pa kãsmã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La a sũ-kiirã pʋge,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a ma wã ra sõngd-a lame,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la a pirsd-a.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Woto wã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: b ra naaga taab n baood b sẽn na n maanega,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: tɩ biigã paam naamã n deeg a ba wã nugẽ.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yaa woto tɩ b ra pugd bagb la tɩt rãmb nao,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n kot sõngre.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: B wa n tɩ yãa tɩɩm soab a yembre.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rao-kãng me tɩɩmã sɩd da wita wa bugum.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A sẽn kelg b koeesã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a sũurã sãama ne-ba.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: N sɩd be bʋʋm me.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yãmb me ges wɛ!
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Biig na rat n dɩ rog-n-mik naam t’a ba nan ket n zĩẽ?
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La ayo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩɩmã soab kell n bʋka a koɛɛgã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n yeel-ba:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: - Mam tõee tʋʋmdã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la yel-tũudg a ye n ya toogo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩ b yeel t’a we n togse.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩ tɩɩmã soab yeel-ba:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: - Mam tõe n sõnga yãmb ne tɩɩm,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: tɩ biigã paam a ba wã geere.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La tɩɩmã tũuda ne yʋʋm piig la a nu yɩbrgo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rẽ me,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yaa yɩbr-vɩɩga.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yãmb sã n tõog n wa ne-a,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yellã na manege.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩɩmã soab sẽn gom n sa,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: pagã ne a biigã yik n loogame.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: B talla tagsgo,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n bʋgsd bãmb sẽn na n maan to-to n paam yʋʋm piig la a nu yɩbrgo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rẽ me,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: maanda a wãn n bãng yʋʋm piig la a nu yɩbrgo?
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: B mak n kongame,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n wa baas n leb tɩɩmã soab nengẽ,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n na n le kos sõngre.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: B sẽn lebg n kẽngã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: raoã kõ-b-la tɩɩm.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩɩm sẽn kɩtd tɩ ninsaal tõe n wʋm yɩbrdã goama.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A le wilga biigã rabaar ning a sẽn na n maane,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n yõk yɩbrgã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A sagl-a lame t’a bao bikalga,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n wʋlg-a rasem a tãabo,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n dɩk-a n zae a yĩngã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n yaool n kẽng kʋk a yembr tẽngre,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n tɩ gãand n maan wala a kiime.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yɩbrdã sẽn wat n sõsd kʋkẽ wã sã n yã-a,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: b na n sigame n dat n dɩ-a.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Woto,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a paamda a ye n yõke.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Biigã sɩd kẽngame n tɩ maan wala tɩɩmã soab sẽn wilgã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A sẽn gãandã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: pa kaoos la yɩbrdã wa zomb kʋkã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n sɩng sõasga.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yɩbrd sã n ta rɩɩb zĩige woto,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yaa kãsmã n dengd n sɩng rɩɩbo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩ yapã yaool n paam sore,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: bãmb me sɩnge.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Pipi yɩbgrã sẽn yɩ laa,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n sigã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: a yɩɩ gegeng-geng n kolg iiã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n yaas n ges-a pemm,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n yeele:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: - Mam yʋʋm pis-nu la woto,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la mam nan ka yã yãoã buud ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Mam nan ka rɩ yãoã buud ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A sẽn yeel woto,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la a sẽn yɩk n looge.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Ye sẽn loogã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la a to me sẽn sigi.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yẽ soabã me kolgame n dong a yublã n gese,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n bas n yeele:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: - Mam tara yʋum pis-naase.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La mam sẽn yi m ma gelle tɛka,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: mam nan pa ri yãoã buud ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Pa rũndã la m na n sɩng ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yẽ me sẽn yeel woto,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la a sẽn be yɩkrẽ.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Sẽn tarẽ n tarẽ wã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yɩbrg a yẽ n wa n yɩk n sigi,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n tar yeng-yeng n dabda.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A sẽn ta wã la a sẽn yeele:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: - Ad tõnd kãsem-dãmbã yaa rabɛɛmba.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rɩɩb me n wa n be ne m zɩ n yã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Bi zɩ n yã tõta yãabo.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Mam sẽn wa moog yʋʋm piig la a nu la woto.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Mam sẽn dɩ bãmbã buud ka be tɛk ye.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: A pa yã n gom n sa la a be biigã yãoog zug rʋʋbẽ,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: t’a na n kolg n geok a nifrã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: tɩ biigã yɩ-a zã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: n gãd a naoã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: T’a tar pig-pig n dat n fãage.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La pa tõe n fãag wɛ.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Biigã talla yɩbrgã n leb tɩɩmã soab nengẽ n na n tɩ kɩs-a.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La tɩɩmã soab yeel-a lame t’a togs yẽ yella sẽn yɩ to-to.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Tɩ biigã togs-a fãa,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: ne yɩbrdã goamã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rẽ masã la tɩɩmã soab yeel-a:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: - M biig sõngo,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: kelg neere:
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: bõe yĩng tɩ fo paam yɩbr-kãngã soabã n yõke?
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Bõe yĩng la a yõorã sẽn na n yɩ koɛɛgã?
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Pa a sẽn tẽed t’a minim la a pãng yɩɩda sẽn deng-b yẽ n dogã?
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Rẽ wã yaa,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: maan dũni rabeem,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: la f maan gũusgu.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yik n kuli.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: La rũndã tɛka,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: yãk tags-beed f yamẽ wã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Yãk sũ-kiĩr f yame wã.
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: Ad Wẽnd sẽn na n kõ foo bũmb ningã,
title: 3 Ned fãa gũ a pʋɩɩre

text: rẽnda bal la fo so.

text: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tẽng a ye n da be,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n boond,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ Ralingnaaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b kʋʋg n boond faag-faag tɩ Ralingi.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bũmb ning sẽn wa ne tengã yʋʋrã me,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yaa tɩ tẽn-kãngã ned ka segd n maan bũmbu,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t'a pa togs naab ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naabã wa n yiisa noor menga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ biig sã n doge,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a yʋʋrã kũun pa segd n ling yẽ ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Fo me pag sã n doge,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ yaa pag tɩ yaa raoa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: fo kẽngda na-yirã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n tɩ reeg biigã yʋʋr be.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Talla woto,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t'a Yellpagindim pag wa roge.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A roga bi-ribla.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Biig sẽn tar rasãnde,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a Yellpagindim ne a pag a Wẽndtõe sũur ya noogo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yaẽ bũmbu,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: b pa baoẽ b yamleoog yʋʋr n pʋd-a.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La tẽngã naab noor deegr yĩnga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: rasem a tãab poore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yibeoog pĩnda,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: b rɩka na-yirã sore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n na n tɩ bõs tɩ b yãk yʋʋr n kõ biigã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B sẽn yi wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: b pa yã n zãag ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bi-pɛɛlgã zĩnda a ma wã poorẽ n yeele:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Lebg-y tɩ d kuli.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Lebg-y tɩ d kul tɩ mam zoe n tara yʋʋre.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Wao!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ad wã yaa dũni yel-soalma !
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Rasem a tãab biig sẽn gomde?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Rẽ me,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a pipi goam yaa naab noor kɩʋʋsgo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Biigã ba ne a ma sẽn wʋm woto,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: rabeem kẽ-b lame.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La ba wã soka biigã:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Tɩ fo yʋʋr la a bõe?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ biigã leoke:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Mam yʋʋr la a Yamyɩɩdnaaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la bool-y maam t’a Yamyɩɩda.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nebã a yiibã yalsa wʋmm,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n pa mi b sẽn maandg ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yell wa yã!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B wa n baas n sɩd lebg n dɩka yir sore.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B kulame n tɩ be yiri,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n vɩ b beoog-beoog fãa vɩɩmã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n tʋmd n dɩtẽ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la b gʋʋnd b kamba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yʋʋm wa n loogame.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a Yamyɩɩd zẽk bɩʋʋngo,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n sɩng zoet n deemd ne a taaba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a ba-rãmb mi n tʋm-a,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a ya lomb-lomb-lombe,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n kẽnd la a watẽ.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Talla woto t’a yʋʋrã wa lʋɩ tẽngã naab tʋbre.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ naab sũurã yiki.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a sok a kug-zĩidbã:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - B yet tɩ Raling ka,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: biig n be t’a yʋʋr la a Yamyɩɩda.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Roga rabʋre?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ãndã n kõ yʋʋrã?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ãndã n so tẽn-kãngã n yɩɩd maam tɩ yell a woto wa lingd maam?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bul n yaa ãndã biĩg sẽ?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ ned a yembr yeel tɩ yaa a Yellpagindim ne a Wẽndtõe biiga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tao bal tɩ naab tʋmame tɩ b tɩ bool a Yellpagindim t’a wa na-yirã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: nif ne a kãmsg pʋge.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Sɩd yɩɩ woto,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a Yellpagindim yɩ zok-zok-zoke,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wa ta n wõgemd n pʋʋse,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - N-Naa!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ yãmb n boonde?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: M waame.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: N-naa!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: TƖ naab sok-a:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Fo biig la Yamyɩɩdã soaba?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Naaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n-ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Ãndã n pʋd biigã yʋʋre?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Naaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: ad-y yaa biigã menga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Biigã menga ?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Fo lebga gãeeng la?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bɩ maam la f rat n daase?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Sẽn ya a soab me,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: fo na bãng tɩ Raling ka,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: maam n so tẽngã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Fo na bãnge,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ mam noor ka kɩɩsd ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yik n kuli,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la f gũ m koɛɛga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yellpagindim yika wʋmm,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n tar lama,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: lama,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: lama,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n teesdẽ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a sũur pibda.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yel-kãngã na n baasa wãn-wãna?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A sẽn ta yirã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a togsa yellã a pag a Wẽndtõe,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b fãa naag taab n zĩ ne sũ-sãanga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Rasem a wãn poore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: zaab-noor sasa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: naab tʋma neb ne kazẽega,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b tɩ kɩs a Yamyɩɩd ma wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t'a reeg n los tɩ lebg kae t’a kõg rãam,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ bãmb pʋʋsa b susoaaga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ ya vẽtembeoogo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La bãmb data rãamã n kõ nebã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La b le paas t’a modg tɩ ra yɩ rã-ãbg ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Pa no-rɩkre?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: N dat tɩ pagã yet t’a pa tõe tɩ b paam n sɩbg-a?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Pagã reega Kazẽegã n dɩgle,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a sɩdã wa t’a wilg-a la a togs-a,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b naag taab n zɩ n bʋʋdẽ.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yel-kãngã maanda a wãna?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Neb a yiibã sẽn nan yeeg neng n zĩe wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a Yamyɩɩd sẽn wa n ta n sok-ba:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Yeelame tɩ bõe Tɩ yãmb y yiib fãa boog n zĩ woto?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ned n ka keem la,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: bɩ ned n maan kaalem?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a ma leoke:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Pa kũum ye,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la ne kũum zem taaba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ad Kazẽegã sẽn dɩge.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naab n kɩs tɩ m kõg rãam tɩ yɩ beoog rãam.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Biigã sẽn wʋmã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a yeela a ma wã ne a ba wã:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Sã n zemsa woto bal bɩ y bas tɩ ka yel-kẽgeng ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Mam na n tɩ sõsa ne naab la m wa.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A sẽn gom woto,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a sẽn kẽ rooge n lebg n yi,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n dɩk na-yirã sore.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a ba-rãmb zĩ n bʋʋdẽ:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: hãnd naab na n tɩ basa b biigã t’a wa laafɩ?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yamyɩɩd taame waa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n pʋʋs naab ne waoogre,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a yeel-ba:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Naaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yãmb sẽn kɩs m ma Kazẽegã yaa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a losa kae wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n dʋgle,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la wamd kae n vaagd kõgr ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yaa rẽ tɩ m watẽ tɩ y sõng-ma.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ad kãand biisi.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: M kotame tɩ y reeg yaa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n bʋd zaabrã tɩ yi n wom yaa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ y kɩɩb tɩ m paam wama.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ad yaa wamã bal la m ma zu-loɛɛga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La bũmb sẽn be,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: wamã sã n pa yɩ wam-wẽgdo,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Wẽnd sõngre,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: rãamã me yɩta sõama.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ naabã sũur puugi,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t'a leok tɩ kãand kõn bʋd rũndã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a yi rũndã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wom dũndã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b paam wam ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Rẽ la a Yamyɩɩd na n yeel naaba:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Ad yaa rẽ sẽn pa tõe wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la m ma me sẽn pa na n tõog tɩ Kazẽegã lebg kae rũndã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a kõg rãam zĩig pʋge wã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naab sẽn wʋm dẽ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a tʋmame tɩ b tɩ reeg Kazẽegã n wa.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La a ra ket n wẽendame bal tɩ yẽ na paam a nin-bãmbã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Rasem a wãn yel-kãensã fãa loogr poore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: naab kɩtame tɩ b tall loalg n tɩ kɩs a Yellpagindma,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a reeg-a n wubi.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yellpagindim sẽn mi tɩ yẽ zakã rãmb ne naab yaa wõg-wõgã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a sɩd pelga a pʋg n na n zã naafã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Wĩndga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yʋngo,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a geta naafã yelle,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ bũmb ra wa maan-a ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A tõogame t’a nob sõama,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n yɛs yolgemde,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n sɩd tar rasãnde.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: naab tʋmame tɩ b tɩ reeg naafã ne a kambã n wa.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yellpagindim sẽn wʋm dẽ wã masã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a yaool n bãng tɩ sẽn kɩs yẽ naafã yaa sẽn na n bẽd n paam-a.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nag-raoog na roge?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Wã pa sẽn dat n dõd bũmb bal n paam yẽ n sɩbge?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a le zĩ ne yɩɩre,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n pa mi a sẽn kẽed zĩig ning n põs yellã ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La a biig a Yamyɩɩd le yeela a baaba t’a ra yaees ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ Wẽnd sã n sake,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yellã na n manegame.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yamyɩɩd basame tɩ yʋn-sʋk ta,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ nebã fãa kẽ gõeem,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ tengã fãa ya sɩɩ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a yi n dɩk a soang n palge,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n tar soa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: soa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: soa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n dabd na-yirã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Pusg n yɛs naabã sɩmande.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A taame n tar koa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: koa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n peesd pusgã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naab wʋma bʋʋrã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n sok tɩ yaa ãndã soab n keed tɩɩg ne yʋngo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B sẽn yi n gese,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: mikame tɩ yaa a Yamyɩɩda.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ naab sok-a tɩ yaa noog tɩ yẽ wa peesd pusgã sasa kãngã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a Yamyɩɩd wẽ siri,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Hũmm.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naaba!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ad yaa yʋn-sʋk yel-yãgdem.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: M baaba n dog yaa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b tʋm-m tɩ m wa pees pusgã n wa tɩ b rʋg n so bi-pɛɛlgã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ naabã yeel-a:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Kelg ka biigã !
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ra yaal maam koe!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yaa bõe goam la woto?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Fo sẽn dogã tɛka yaa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: fo zoe n wʋmame tɩ rao rog yã?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T’a Yamyɩɩd wẽneg n yeele:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - M tõe n bãng tɩ yãmb yet tɩ yãmb nag-raoogã yãmb sẽn da kɩs m baaba wã segd n tara nag-bi?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A sẽn yeel woto wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: naabã bãnga masã tɩ biigã gom n lub-a lame.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A kɩtame tɩ b tɩ tall loalgã n wa.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La a ra ket n wẽendame tɩ yẽ sẽn sɩbg bi-kãngã bal n be.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naab sẽn mik t’a pa tõe n bẽd biigã bɩ a ba-rãmbã n paamã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a yeela a kug-zĩidbã tɩ biigã na n wãa tẽngã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La rẽ yĩngã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: bɩ b kʋ-a.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B tʋmame tɩ b tɩ yõk-a n wa na-yirã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A sẽn wa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: b kɩtame tɩ b sui-a yolg pʋga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n yaool n yãk neb a yiibu,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ b tʋk yolgã n na n tɩ lob mogrã pʋga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naab keoog neb a yiibã woto:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Haya!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Maan-y gũusg hal wʋsgo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Kõb-wẽn-kãngã sɩlmã la y sẽn mi wã la.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Da maan-y-yã a raabo,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: ra kelg-y-yã a goama.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ lob-y-yã-a mogrã pʋg bala.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bãmbã me sẽn wʋm dẽ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: b vaaga b sor n tar yõarg n dabd mogrẽ wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n na n tɩ lob a Yamyɩɩda.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La b yet tɩ Wẽnd pa kʋ naab pa kʋʋd ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Mogrã ziig sẽn zãr yĩnga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: neb a yiibã kẽname n wa ya,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n zĩnd tɩɩg tẽngre,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n na n pems bilf la b yaool n yiki.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B wa n nee yĩisr naoor sẽn kaoog t’a keoosd n loogdẽ.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Na yaa tãoos n pogl-a n yaool n pa paam-a bɩ bõe?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nebã a yiibã basa b yolgã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n na n dig yiisrã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B rig-a lame n zãage.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Sasa-kãnga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Silmiig n wa n loogd ne a niiga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n tũ tɩɩgã tẽngre,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n yã yolgã sẽn dɩgã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A ta n dɩka a rasaarã n wẽ yolgã la a gomd a yembre:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Yaa ãnd soab n yĩm a yolg ka?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yamyɩɩd zĩnda yolgã pʋg n yeele:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Hũmm !
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Y maand-m-la pãnga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: N yet tɩ m pa rat n yɩ naaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tɩ y rat n modg-m n kõ naam.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ayo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: M pa rat n yɩ naab ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Silmiigã sẽn wum a Yamyɩɩd goamã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a tẽedame tɩ sɩd yaa ned la b yõk n dat n tɩ kõ naam,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a soabã pa rat ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tao bala,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a loka yolgã noore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a Yamyɩɩd yi.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La a yeelame tɩ sẽn ya woto wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: rẽnd yẽ na n deega biigã zĩiga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A sɩd kẽe yolge wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a Yamyɩɩd maneg a noorã n sebg sõama,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a bas n peeg a niigã n looge.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nebã a yiibã me riga yĩisrã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wa mik tɩ b pa na n paam-a ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ b lebg n wa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wa tʋk b yolgã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n le rɩk mogrã sore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la b gomd woto:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Haya!
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: D zẽk naoore.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Mas-masã tɩ d pa ta mogrẽ wã n lobg kõb-wẽn-kãngã la d paamd d menga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Silmiigã sẽn wʋm goamã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a bãngame t’a lʋɩɩ yell pʋga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: T'a zĩnd yolgẽ wa n yeele:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Walaasi mam ka kõb-wẽng ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Mam yaa Silmiiga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ neb a yiibã leok-a:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - F lebga Silmiig masã?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bas rẽ la f lebg Marenga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: F yet tɩ f sɩlem waoog laa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: so-kãngã yẽ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: fo kiime bala.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B ra tẽedame tɩ yaa a Yamyɩɩd n maand dabaare,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n teem a koɛɛgã n dat n belg bãmba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La Silmiigã zĩnda yolgẽ wã n le yeele:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Ka sɩlem ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Mam dat n yɩɩ naaba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tɩ b yeel-a:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Fo rat n yɩɩ naaba?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ka ne bilf bala,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: d sã n lob-f mogrã pʋga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: f kõn tɩ rɩ naam be ne zĩmã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: rendeedã la yẽbsã?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Silmiigã bee yolgã pʋg n tar gõgneng la gãgnengo,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la nebã a yiibã ra ka le kelgd-a ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B taa mogrẽ wã n lob-a be faoo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La b lebg n zãensdẽ n kuiisẽ,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n ta n togs naab t’a Yamyɩɩd yũug menma dũniya.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A Yamyɩɩd peega Silmiigã niiga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wa ne yiri,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wẽ yãgr n ning-ba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Rasem a wãn poore,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a pẽe bĩisim zembala,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n tʋk n kẽng na-yirã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n na n tɩ kõ naaba.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nebã sẽn yã-a wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: b pɛleng yɩkame.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B ra bʋgsdame:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: hãnd pa biigã kɩɩm n wa n na bugs bãmba?
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Sã n ya ne naabã menga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yẽ ra tagsdame tɩ raar ninga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: nebã tek n basa a Yamyɩɩd t’a põse,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a sẽn lebg n wa wã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: La a Yamyɩɩd taame waa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n pʋʋs naaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la a yeel-a:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: - Naaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: ad m wat n na n bãnga y keelem yaa,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: la m pʋʋs m zaamẽ beoogo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yãmb maan maam neere.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yaa sɩda,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: yãmb sẽn kɩt tɩ b tɩ lob maam mogrẽ wã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: mik tẽn-noog n be be.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Be rãmbã yãka b laogã bilf bal n kõ maam:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: niig koabga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: B yeelame tɩ mam wa reeg naam be menga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Ka ne rasem a wãna,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: m na n lebame,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: maam ne tõnd zakã rãmb fãa.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nananda,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: reeg-y bĩisim.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yaa mam niigã bĩisim.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naabã sẽn wʋm woto,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: a kɩtame tɩ b yõk biigã n pag roogo.,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A yaool n yeelame tɩ b bao yondo,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n sui yẽ zakã rãmb fãa:
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: na-pagbã,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: ne kambã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Yẽ mengã yaool n kẽe yol-bedr pʋga,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n yet tɩ b sẽb yondã noy sõama,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n wʋk-b n tɩ lob mogrẽ wã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Bala,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: tẽn-noog a woto ka tog ne kõb-wẽng wala a Yamyɩɩd ye.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Nebã sɩd wʋk-b lame n tɩ lob mogrẽ wã.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naabã ne a zakã rãmb fãa kell n yii dũni woto.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Tẽngã rãmb yaool n yõd n yãa taaba,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: n dɩk a Yamyɩɩd n zaoolg naamã geer zugu,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a rɩ naamã bãmb sʋka,
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: t’a yaa bi-yẽesg sẽn tar yam.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: A yaa beoog biiga.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Zʋg la zem-zem.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: Naam buudã fãa segd n dɩɩ ne zemsgo.
title: 4 A Yamyɩɩd kibare

text: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Soaamb yika raar a yembr n saada,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: n saad ka-tʋʋm saabo.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A wa n sega wobgo.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A sẽn maag a meng n ges wobgã,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: a sɩd tara pãnga.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A sẽn loog n ta kʋɩlgẽ wã n na n yũ koom,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: a yãa yemde.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A sẽn ges yemd-me,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: yẽ me wẽnda a tara pãnga.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: T’a bʋgsdẽ :
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: ãndã pãng n yɩɩd a to menga?
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: La maanda a wãn n bãnge?
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A soaamb yẽ na bãnga.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A yikame n kẽng n tɩ bao a wĩ-kagbre,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: n tɩ yã wobgo,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: n yeel-a:
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: - M ba Wobgo,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: ad mam naaf n sud kʋɩlgã noor yaa,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: tɩ m dat n wa bõos-y tɩ y sõng-m tɩ m yiis-a.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Tɩ wobg yeel-a:
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: - M dat f sõngr wɛ,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: la maanda a wãna?
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Tɩ soaamb yeele:
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: - Yãmb pa ne wĩirã,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: yãmb sã n gãd no-kãngã wã yaa,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: tɩ mam tɩ loe naafã ne noor a to wã yaa,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: yãmb kõn tak-a n yiis faag-faaga?
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Tɩ wobg yet t'a wʋm ya.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Soaamb yaool n yeela wobg t’a sã n tɩ loe a naafã n sa,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: a na n wẽe bendr naoor a tã,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: t’a yaool n sɩng takre.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A sẽn yɩ kudi,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: a tɩ yãa yemde,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: n togs yẽ me boto,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: tɩ yẽ naaf n be weoogã pʋga,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: t’a wat n na n kos-a t’a tak-a n kõ-a.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Yemd sẽn yet t’a sakame wã,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: la a sẽn yeel yẽ me t’a gũ bendrã wẽebo.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: A sẽn bas yemd la a sẽn yɩ põe,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: põe,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: n babsd a bendrã,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: n ta n ning-a pidim,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: pidim n bas n sor n getẽ.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Tɩ pãn-dãmb a yiibã na n tak taaba.
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

text: Wobg yɩta yemd yeddd,
title: 5 Soaamb yel-baoore

title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: n kẽed weoogã n yet t’a leb n paama a zaabr dɩɩbo.
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: A sẽn wa n na n bãngã,
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: yaa bõnyẽeg sẽn tir n yaase.
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: Katr sẽn wẽneg n maag a yĩng n gese,
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: a mikame tɩ yɩɩda peosgo:
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: yaa we-naab menga.
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: T’a wẽ fuss,
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: n kʋɩ tĩiga,
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: n fãood beoosã la tuudã,
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: n baood a menga.
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: Yɩɩ woto tɩ katr na n lak n bas pʋg-yãangã.
title: 8 M ba Katr kãoongo

text: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a yirã rãmba.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: baag zaba ne a yirã rãmba.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Zabrã yɩɩ rɩɩb poorẽ.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Baag yeelame tɩ zakã rãmb sã n na n kõ yẽ rɩɩbo,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: b basdame n dɩ n sa n yaool n kõ yẽ t’a rɩ.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Rẽ me,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: b pa sukd zẽed n kõt yẽ ye.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Daar fãa,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: yaa sag-wẽema,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: wall sagb sẽn wãds-wãds n los koomẽ.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Woto yĩngã,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: a yik n zoe n kẽnga weoogẽ wã n tɩ vɩ be.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: A tɩ mika we-baag be,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n yõg zood ne-a,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: tɩ b yiibã be be,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n yõgd rũmsã n wãbde,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: tɩ b vɩɩm ya-b noogo.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: b wa n nee saagã sẽn kʋɩ n limsi,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: tɩ b tar sẽm-sẽm-sẽme,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n baood zĩig n na n soonde.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Zu-noogo,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: b yãa tãng boko,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n zoe n kẽ be.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Zu-buko,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: katr doogo.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Katrã me zoee saagã,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n tar burga-burga n wat a roogẽ.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: A sẽn ta n lɩk bal la a sẽn ne bãmbã sẽn dõbe.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n bas n yet tɩ Wẽnd kũun yɩɩd baoobo.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Sasa kãng tɩ yir baag tara rigb kob-kob-kobe,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n tol n zoe n kɩrg rʋʋd-koom la a sã bĩungu.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: La a we-baaga yeela katre:
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: - B ba Katre,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: yãmb gomdã yaa gõaag zugu.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Yaa sɩd bal pae !
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Wẽnd kũun sɩd yɩɩd baoobo.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Ad a Baag zaba ne a yirã rãmba,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n dat n sɩbg a zu-soabã.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Yaa rẽ la a wat n na n yeel-y tɩ y maneg yãgre,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: t’a tɩ peeg a zu-soabã niig n wa n kõ-yã,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: tɩ y bĩng n tar n wãbd y yam.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Katr sẽn wʋm dẽ,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: a sũurã yɩɩ noog zuddd.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: T’a yeele:
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: - N-faa!
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Yɩlem be.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Sã n mik tɩ yaa woto,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: mam na n yik n sɩnga yãgrã maanegre.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: La we-baag soka Katre:
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: - La saagã?
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Yãmb pa zoet saagã ?
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Y pa na n yaas t’a yooge ?
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Tɩ katr yeele :
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: - Saaga ?
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Saag kʋʋda katr la ?
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Foom a we-baag mengã waa.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Rẽndame tɩ fo mengã yik n yãag a yir baaga,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: tɩ y maan tao-tao.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Modg-y tɩ naaf ba a ye ra pa ye.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Peeg-y ne nag-bi wã fãa.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Haya!
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: wudg-y n kẽng-y la y wa.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Ra kaoos-y ye.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: B sẽn bas katr n zãag bilfu,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: laa yir baag sẽn kʋɩ tĩiga.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Yaa yir sor dɩkr bala.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Wã n le yas n pʋʋsd zoa wẽnd na taase?
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Baraar tɛka,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: yir baag pa le zab ne a zu-soab rɩɩb poorẽ ye.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: A rɩta a sẽn paame,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: n yetẽ meng tɩ rɩɩbã rɩta togem-togem.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Sasa-kãngã tɩ yaa a sẽn paam sagbã n dɩte tɩ maan bʋʋr ningã.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: A sã n le kẽng weoog me,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: yaa a tɩ kaag la a wa kɛ.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: A yam pa le kõt-a t’a tɩ vɩɩnd be ye.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Saag ling-a me,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: a zoet n wata yiri.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Moosã sẽn mi n yetẽ tɩ f sã n bas f rɩẽ yaoore,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: tãmbeok la f gɩĩudã,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: b pa yag ye.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: Rat n yet tɩ fo sã n sãbs bũmbu,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: f zug sã n pa yɩ noogo,
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: sẽn pa são rẽ la f na n tɩ rɩke.
title: 9 Ad a Baag zaba ne a

text: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Kom-kẽeng n wa n wa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tɩ yɩl n yã bõn-koodr meng n sẽgemd yẽnd mengã yaa toogo.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Fo sẽn lebe fãa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: yaa komã yell bal la b tar goama.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Na n maana a wãn n põse?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: M ba Soaamb kẽe yʋng a ye n mak gõeem n konge.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A tagsa a sẽn na n maan to-to,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n paam n tɩlg ne a zakã rãmba.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: La Soaamb n kongd dabaar bɩ?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A ninga a yamẽ wã t’a tõe n belga a Katr yalem-zaallã n paam n yi yelle wã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Beoogã sẽn vẽegã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a kẽngame n tɩ yã m ba Katre,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n yeel-a:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - M ba Katre,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: yãmb nee rõandã komã la,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tõnd sã n pa tall yam fãa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tõnd pa na n yi seoogã ye.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: T’a Katr yet tɩ yaa sɩda.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: T’a Soaamb yeel-a :
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - Ade.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Yãmb pa ne tɩ tõnd ma-rãmbã kʋʋlame sɩda?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: B yõod yaa bõe?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: B sẽn tõe masã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: yaa beoog vẽeg tɩ b zĩe n gũudẽ tɩ rɩɩb wa bala,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tɩ b rɩ.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Y ka ne tɩ b yõodã pa le waoog sɩda?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Wa-y tɩ d yõg-b yaa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n tɩ koos Belgyalem daaga.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Rẽ,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: d paamd n daa koodo,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n tõog n yi sẽoogã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Mam sẽn togsd yãmb woto wã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: ad yaa yãmb sõngre.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Yaa maam ne yãmb sẽn ya zoodã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Modg-y tɩ ned a to ra wʋm ye.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Ka rẽ,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: nebã wʋsg na n kẽesa b ma-rãmb raaga,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tɩ ma-rãmbã wa nare,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n ka le raad sõama ye.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Woto wã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: wa-y tɩ d maan tao-tao.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Katr pẽga a Soaamb sõama,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n yetẽ t’a yaa burkĩna.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A sẽn ta yiri,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tao bal t’a sɩnga raagã kẽnd seglgo.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A baoo wĩir sẽn ya bedre,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n tar pãnga,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n pid a ma wã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n le ning-a kadr n paase,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: t’a tirsde.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Soaamb me sẽn ta yiri,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a seglga a menga:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a baoo wĩ-kʋdr sẽn ya tõsd-tõsdo,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n pid a ma.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A yaool n yeel-a lame:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - Tõnd na n tũu taab ne a Katr n kẽng Belgyalem daaga.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: La yaa sẽn na n tɩ koos foo ne a Katr ma.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Sã n ta Paamemmeng kʋkã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: bɩ f vege,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tɩ wĩirã na n kaoogame,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tɩ f paam n lebg n zoe n wa yiri.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: B fãa sɩd yiime,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n dɩk sor n dabd raagã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Soaamb ma sɩd tek n vegemdame,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: wala b sẽn da sara,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: tɩ wĩirã tõsge,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: t'a zõond n kelem wala a sũurã sɩd sãama ne a ma wã wĩir kaoogre.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: La a Katr sɩnga a Koaamb goam woto:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - Ad fo mengã sɩd yaa yelle!
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Wĩ-kãngã yaa sẽn na tall n pid f ma t’a pa kaooge?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: La f yalemdã yaa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: f pa yɛs zaalem masã?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Woo,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: ay !
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Lebg n kul wɛ !
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Ned kẽng tao-tao n tɩ koos f ma yaa !
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A sẽn yeel woto,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a vɩlemdame n dɩk a sor n taet a ma n tutẽ.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A taa raagẽ wã n koos-a,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n deeg ligdã n yãk n da ki,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: kamaana,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: hal ne zẽ-biis fãa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n lebg n dɩk sor n lengd n kuiisẽ,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: t’a sũur noome.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Mik a Soaamb sẽn lebgã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a pa kul ye.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A paa sorã nonr n gũud m ba Katr lebgre.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A sẽn wa n tool n yã a sẽn watã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a gãanda sorã zugu,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n maan wala a kiime.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Katr sẽn wa n yã-a,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: la a sẽn gom a pʋge woto:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - M mi tɩ yaa komã n kʋ yãoã wɛ !
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Sẽn pa tar-a rabaar kõn yi sẽoogã ye.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: La a tutẽ.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A sẽn loogã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a Soaamb yikame,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n kẽ weoogã n gil a Katre,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n le ta taoor n gãand sorã zugu.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Katr sẽn le yã soaambã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: la a sẽn yeele:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - Ad komã na n saa bãmbã buudã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: M da mi tɩ na yɩ woto.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Y buud ka bark wɛ.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: N pit y ma-rãmb ne wĩ-põaas tɩ kaoodẽ!
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: La a tar sãagre.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Soaamb kell n maana woto naoor a nu.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Katr wa n yeelame:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: - Ad mam mengã yaa yalma.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Sooms a wãn masã?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: M sã n da wʋkdẽ bãmbã yaa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: ka m tɩ yãk n dʋg n paam bɩɩm n fʋrge,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: la m yãk n kʋɩɩse.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Tao bal t’a sika a raagã teed n dɩgle,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: la a bas n kʋɩ tĩig n na n babs poorẽ soomsã.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Sasa kãng la a Soaamb tik n yik zãe !
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: N vaag Katr yolgã ne a teedã fãa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n tar põe,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: põe,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: põe n pãrgd weoogã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n kũiis a yiri,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: n na n tɩ rɩ koodã ne a ma,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A Katr sẽn dɩk sorã,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a pa yã soaamb ba a ye.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: A sẽn lebg n wa a teedã zĩigẽ me,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a pa ne soaamba,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: a pa ne yolgo.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: T’a zõond n kelme.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Yẽ n ka a ma,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: yẽ n ka koodo.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Moos yet tɩ bag sã n bʋg-fo,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: bɩ fʋg f menga.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Ned sã n yeel-f bũmbu,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: bɩ fo me tags n paase.
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: Yãmb me ges wɛ:
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: sã n pa a Katr yaa,
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: ma na koose?
title: 10 D koos d ma-rãmbã

text: 11 Kɩɩba.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: Biig a ye n da be,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: t’a ba wã ne a ma wã ki,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: n bas-a t'a ya kɩɩba.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: A ba wã sẽn pa yɩ rakãagr yĩnga,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: a pa bas-a ne ligdi,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: a pa bas-a ne zaka,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: a pa bas-a ne bãgre.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: Roor bal la biigã ra tara.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: A ra saada weoogã ne a roorã n lobd sʋya.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: a yãa sʋʋr sẽn be kãoongẽ,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: t'a lobge,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: tɩ roorã pa kãoongẽ wã.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: Kãoongã gõos yĩnga,
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: a ra pa tõe n yãk a roorã ye.
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: A ra yɛsame n yɩɩnd woto:
title: 11 Kɩɩba

text: 1 Yõens yelle
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: yõensã tigma taab n na n ges b sẽn tog n maaneg ne m ba yũuga.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: B sɩd yãa taab n yeele :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: « D sã n pa bao yam rũn-kãngã yĩnga,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: a na n wãa d zagsã».
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: B sɩd wẽe taab no-koɛɛma,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: n wa yãk tags-kãngã n wilgi :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: « Sẽn dog-a n yaa yõngr buud fãa wa ne a nug bũmbu :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: tãmba.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: D na n daa lombr n loe yũug yublã.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Rẽ,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: a sã n na n pẽneg tõnd nin-yend fãa d wʋmda a rãamde».
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: B saka tagsgã,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: n sɩng ligd-lobrã reesgo :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: yõngr fãa tʋma a nug a loaabẽ n yiis ligdi.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: La yõensã sʋka,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: a ye n da be n da sɩd yaa tal-kʋdre.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Sẽn wa n ta yẽ wã,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: a sẽn da pa tar ligdã a yeelame :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: « Yaas-y-yã,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: m tara bũmb n na n togse.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Mam pa tar ligd ye,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: la m na n maoome n paam n kɩse.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: La mam datame n deng n bãnge yaa yõng-bʋg n na n tɩ loe lombrã yũugã yublẽ.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Y sã n yã yõng-kãnga,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: mam na kɩs m ligdã.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: La yõng-kãng sã n pa yã,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: mam pa na n kɩs fʋɩ».
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: B sɩngame n na n bao yõngr ninga,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: b fãa sʋkã,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: sẽn na n tɩ sẽbg-a lombrã yũugã yublẽ,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: la b pa tol n paam yõngr ba a ye sẽn yeele :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: « Aoo,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: mam na n tɩ loee lombrã yũugã yublẽ ye».
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Woto wã,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: b fãa lebs n deesa b ligd n sui b loobsẽ.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: Yõng-talgã me talla tags-sõngo :
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: a ra pa tar ligdi,
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: la yẽ n tall taogsg n yɩɩg a taabã.
title: 1 Yõens yelle

text: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: Weoogẽ wã,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: kʋɩl-kẽeng sẽn da tar rasãnd n da be,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: tɩ rũmsã fãa tʋgd n yũud be.
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: D mi tɩ rũmsã fãa sʋka,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: b fãa zoeta bõnyẽega,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: ba wobg meng bedrem sẽn yɩɩd b fãa wã zoet-a lame.
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: b taa kʋɩlgẽ wã n na n yũ koom,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: n yã,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: ne lingr sẽn ya kasenga,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: tɩ kʋɩlgã kʋɩɩme,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: tɩ ko-beell meng ka be ye.
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: Tɩ rũmsã ra tigim taab n sokd b mens n getẽ :
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: « Yaa yɛɛnẽ la d na n kẽng n tɩ paam koom n yũ »?
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: B sẽn da tigim taab n baood yellã tɩɩmã,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: la bõnyẽeg sẽn poog n sɩng kʋnkʋma :
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: « Yaa ãnd n sa kʋɩlgã koom zãnga »?
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: M ba katr sẽn da yasã,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: bõnyẽeg kẽesa-la rabeem-sablga,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: t'a yeele :
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: « Ges-y-yã,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: tõnd sokd d mens n na n bãng ned ning sẽn kʋɩɩs-a kʋɩlgã tɩ reoog be ka n laadẽ »!
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: « Ayo,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: katre »,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: reoog rabaamã sẽn yeele,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: » yaa m ba naaf la y tog n gese,
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: bala a yõyã madgame.
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: Tõe tɩ yaa yẽ n sa koomã »!
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: Tɩ bõnyẽeg yɩk n zomb naaf n wãb-a.
title: 2 Kʋɩlga kʋɩɩme

text: 3 Katre ne wãamba
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Tẽngã neb ra yãka yarn tɩ wakatã taame tɩ b na n bẽd katr tãoog n kʋ-a.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Rẽnd b kẽnga weoogẽ wã n tɩ tu bog-zulunga,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: sẽn na yɩɩ tɩ katr lʋɩ a pʋgẽ.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Katr sẽn da pa mi bẽodgã tiirã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: a yii yʋng a ye n gõod weoogẽ wã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: n lʋɩ bokã pʋga.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Wãamb sẽn da tũud a sor yãa bokã n kolg n na n ges sẽn ya bũmb ninga.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: A yãa katr n sok-a :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Yaa bõe n kẽes foo bog-kãngã pʋga »?
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Tɩ katr yet tɩ yʋngã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: yẽ sẽn yi gõodem weoogẽ wã la a Iʋɩ bokã pʋga la a pa le tõe n yi ye.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Tɩ wãamb yeele :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Mam sã n yiis foo bokẽ wã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: f na n bas-m la laafɩ tɩ m looge »?
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Tɩ katr yeele :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « N-ye sẽ !
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Fo sã n yiis maam bog-kãngã pʋga,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: sɩd yĩnga m kõn maan-f wẽeng ye.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Tɩ wãamb kɩs-a a zuurã n tak-a n yiis bokẽ wã.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: A sẽn yi n paam a meng yasã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: katr gãda wãamb zʋʋre.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Bas m zʋʋr wɛ »!
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Ayo,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: bala rasem a yopoe la woto mam sẽn be bog-kãngã pʋga,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: m ninã pa le ne sõma ye».
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Sɩdã ,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: ra yaa padeng gomde :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: katr ra ratame n wãb wãamba,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: t'a bul kibar n yet tɩ yẽ sẽn maan rasem a yopoe bokã pʋgã a ninã pa le ne sõma ye.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Yals bilfu,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: beoogã sã n vẽege,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: m na bas f zʋʋrã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: tɩ f paam n looge ».
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: B sẽn yas n wẽed no-koɛɛma,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: la soaamb sẽn ta.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: A sẽn da ne tɩ b sũyã zabda ne taabã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: a sokame :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Yaa bõe n maane ?
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Yaa bõe tɩ yãmb yasẽ tɩ yaa no-koɛɛm woto »?
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Wãamb yeelame tɩ yẽ ra gõodame,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: n wa ta ka n yã katrã bok pʋga.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: T'a sok-a :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: m sã n yiis-f bokã pʋga f na n bas-m lame tɩ m loog n pa maan-m wẽenga »?
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: T'a leok-m tɩ n-ye,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: la mam sẽn yiis a n sa wa,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: a pa le rat n bas m zʋʋrã ye ».
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Soaamb yãka yam n na n yɩ bag-naaba,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: bag-rãmbã naab n bao n welg yellã tɩ sãmbg ra zĩnd ye :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « sã n yaa woto,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: bɩ y pʋg maam n wa tɩ-kãngã tẽngr tɩ y na yã tɩ m na n bãngame n welg yãmb y yiibã sʋka,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: ned ning sẽn tar-a bʋʋm la ned ning sẽn pa tar-a bʋʋm.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: " B tũu taab n kẽng tɩɩgã tẽngr tɩ soaamb rɩk manesem sẽn wilgd t'a bʋgda sõmb-sõmbo.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: N wa yeele :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « m bʋga m bagre :
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: rẽndame tɩ doaag maane.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Maam a bag-naab sẽn yaa mo-kasengã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: mam tog karma alkʋrãanã seb kẽere,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: la wakat kãnga,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: yãmb ned kam fãa sõmb n fõgna a neng a nusã pʋga.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Rẽ bal n tõe tɩ katr paam n dɩ a rɩɩbã tɩ gɩgdr ka zĩnd ye,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: la a kell n tõog n vɩɩmd n be laafɩ».
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Ad soaamb a bag-naab sẽn yeele,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « mosã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: m na n karma bilf n kõ-yã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: la y rɩkda y nusã n lud y ninã.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Wãamba,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: sẽn na yɩl n sɩbg-a a sẽn pa tagsã yĩnga,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: togame n dʋ tɩɩgã rẽ pʋʋre.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Maam a bag-na-kẽenga,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: mam tog n zoe n kẽe pitã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: la sã n yaa ne katre,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: yẽ tog n dɩɩ a rɩɩb ne yam-basre.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: « Katr ne wãamb ra na n tũẽ-la soaamb sẽn yeelã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: fo sã n dɩk f nus n pĩ f nini,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: f pa le tõe n gãd ned zʋʋr ye.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Rẽnd katr basa wãamb zʋʋrã,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: t'a bãngame t'a na n tõog n dɩ-a-la ne yam-basre.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Bag-naab ra nan pa sa a goamã la wãamb zoe tao-tao n dʋ tɩɩgã ye,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: tɩ soaamb menem moogã pʋg weoogẽ wã tɩ katr yas a ye tãa.
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Rẽ daar tɛka,
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: wãamb yʋʋr lebga «a pa tagsde».
title: 3 Katre ne wãamba

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: soaamb da baooda sõngr n na n tʋm a tʋʋm-kasenga,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: n tɩ kos ninsaalb tɩ b wa sõng-a.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: A yeel-b lame t'a na n kʋʋ yemd biig la wobg biig n maan rɩɩb n kõ-b tɩ b rɩ.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: A sẽn pʋlem-b woto wã,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: b fãa yeelame t'a yagdame,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: tɩ bala yẽ a soaamb pa tõe tɩ yemsã la wobdã tũ yẽ raab ye.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: Soaamb kẽngame n tn yã yemd n yeel-a :
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: « Kõ maam f biigã.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: M na n wub-a lame.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: Yʋʋmdã sã n vẽke,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: m na tall-a n wa kõ-fo,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: la wakat kãnga f na yã t'a bedrem na n yɩɩga foo».
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: Tɩ yemd sak n kõ-a a biigã t'a tug n wubi.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: Soaamb loogame n tɩ yã wobg n yeel-a :
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: « Zĩig n be kaanẽ sẽ,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: koomã tẽn-sʋka,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: tɩ m sã n tall-f n kẽng be,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: bɩ f sũur na n yɩ noogo,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: bala rɩɩb wʋsg bee be.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: F na n kõ-m-la f biigã tɩ m tɩ wub-a be».
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: A sẽn paam Wobg biigã,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: a loogame.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: Soaamb lebgame n tɩ ya ninsaalba,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: n kos-b tɩ b maan tuʋmdã.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: A kʋʋ rũms a yiibã koamb n kõ tʋntʋmdbã tɩ b rɩ.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: Kiuug a yoob loogr poore,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: soaamb wa n kẽnga kʋɩlgẽ wã.
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: " Hey,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

text: yemde,
title: 4 Soaamba ne wobgo ne

title: 9 Bɛdenga

text: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa.

text: b yãka yam n yeel tɩ ned pa le tõe n wɩd a to ye.

text: Tɩ ned sã n wɩd a to,

text: a soab na n lʋɩɩme n ki.

text: Ned sẽn wɩd-a a tũud-n-taag fãa na n lʋɩɩme n ki.

text: M ba soaamb sẽn yaa rũng sɩlem sẽn yɩɩd rũms a taabã,

text: a tʋg n baoo kʋmba n kẽng n tɩ send pĩig kugr zugu.

title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: fo sã n wɩd f yaka,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: La,

text: ned sa n da yaool n yã a,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: a soab ra na n sokame :
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: m ba soaamba,

title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: sẽn be,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: ka tõe n wɩd ye,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: tɩ f sã n pa rat n lʋɩ n ki.
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: Yɩɩwoto tɩ m ba kãoong daar a yembre - yẽ la sẽn pa tar zoobd la- tʋk kaam n kẽnda.
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: A ra miime tɩ m ba soaamb ra sela kʋmb pĩig kugr zugu,

text: t'a tees n dabd a nengẽ.
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: M ba soaamb sẽn yã m ba kãoong sẽn watã,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: Hey,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: m ba kãoongo,

text: yaa ya la f rabda ?

text: yell kae ye,

text: Yaa b sẽn yet tɩ b ra wɩdã kae,
title: 10 Yam yɩɩd m zoa

text: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Rao a ye n da bãnge t'a zoa a ye sẽn da vɩ tẽn-pẽtg a ye pʋga,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: n da pa rat n kõ ned bũmb lae-lae ye,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: la a ra pa tẽed t'a ra tõeeme n tõdg n pa reeg ned sãand ye.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Daar a ye,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: a yãka yam n na n tɩ ges-a.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: A sɩnga kẽn n dabd a nengẽ.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: A ye wã sẽn yã-a t'a be zĩ-zãorgã,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: a zoeeme n tɩ yã a pagã n yeel-a :
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: « Mam zoa a ye n wate,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: la d pa tog n maan dɩɩb a yĩng bal ye »!
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Kaoosame tɩ sãanã sẽn gãe pĩir zugã wa yaa wala a gõeeme.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Sũ-kĩ-nedã tagsame tɩ wakat kãnga a tõe n paama bũmb n dɩ,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: n kɩt tɩ b na n dʋg bɛng n kõ-a.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Bɛngã sẽn wa n bɩ,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: pagã sik-a-la bugmẽ wã n tall n wa tẽgen a sɩdã sɛɛgẽ,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: n ket n tagsdẽ tɩ b sãanã gõeeme.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: La a ra pa gõe ye.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: A wẽgsa bilfu,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: n dõneg a menga,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: sẽn na yɩl tɩ zakã soab bãng t'a neeme.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: « Ha,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: m gãag soaba,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: f pa gõe la »?
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: « Ayo,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: m pa gõe ye ».
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: « La sẽn be,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: f pa tog n gũ bũmb ye.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Woto wã yaa bɛng d sẽn dog n bʋd rõandã «.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Sãanã yikame n na n loog n pa tol n dɩ ye.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: A pẽnega sũ-kĩ-nedã,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: n dɩk a korgã,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: n dɩk bɛngã n kiig a korgã pʋga.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: « Yaa bõe yĩng tɩ f rɩkd m bɛnga »?
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: « Fo yeelame tɩ yaa bɛng sẽn na n bʋde.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Woto wã,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: tõnd nengẽ,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: a buud ka be ye.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Rẽ wã,
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: m na n ninga m korgã pʋg n tɩ bʋde.
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: Mam nan pa seg bɛng-kãngã buud m sẽn beẽ wã ye »!
title: 11 Rao a ye ne a zoa

text: D nee vẽeneg tɩ zood a woto pa na n tol n yɩ zood hakɩɩk sẽn tar pang ye.
