text: 12 Yũug ne yõense
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Zak a ye n da be n yaa talga,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: n da tar yũug a ye bala.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Tigr daar n wa n ta,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: tɩ bũmb buud ra pa be n na n segl n dɩ ye.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Zakã soab ra pa tar tẽeb ne bũmb a to tɩ sã n pa a kʋ yũugã n kõ a pagã t'a seg;
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: tigrã yĩng ye.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Rao wã sẽn da rat n yõk yũugã,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: a pagã yeelame :
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: « Fo sẽn pa tar bũmb sẽn na dɩ wã mam na n kẽnga m roagdb nengẽ,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: bal m doagdbã nengẽ bũmb bee sẽn na dɩ,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: sõma tigr fãa wakato.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Mam pa be ka naong yĩng ye ».
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: A põda a teed n looge.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: La a sẽn da yi a zakẽ wã daar sẽn zãagã,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: a ra pa mi t'a ba wã ligd zãng ra pĩnd n saa hal daar zãorg ye.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: A sẽn ta wã,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: a mikame tɩ roogã paga-me.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: A ma ra loogame tɩ ra yaa a ba wã la sẽn da pag roogã n gũudẽ tɩ yõens yi wa.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Pagã ra pa tõe n bãng tɩ rag n yaa a ba wã n pag zãng woto n dat tɩ yɩ libsg tɩ yõens yi ye.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: T'a tak kʋɩlengã n lak zãnga.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: T'a baaba na n zabe :
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: « Kẽ !
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Ra pak kʋɩlengã tɩ yõensã loog ye »!
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: La a ket n tar goam ne sũ-yikri :
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: « Yaa yalem bʋg n wa n pak kʋɩlengã n kɩt tɩ m yõens looge ?
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Mam da ratẽ lame n dɩẽ tigrã sõma,
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: la mosã wã fo wa n kɩtame tɩ yõensã looge »!
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Ba wã ket n tara a bi-puglã porbo.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: Rẽ kɩtame t'a na n tagse :
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: a sɩd ra tara yũug n da na n kʋ.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: A kẽnga a roagdb nengẽ n tɩ mik t'a ba pag kʋɩleng n dat n yõg yõense.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: « Rẽnd m sɩdã nengẽ n são ».
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: A lebgame n kuil a yiri.
title: 12 Yũug ne yõense

text: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: rao a ye n da yãk yam n na n kẽ kãadem.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A pagã manesem rag n da pa sõmb ye.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Sɩd me,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: pag sã n segl n sa,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: sẽn segd yaa tɩ pagã meng n tẽgend a sɩdã rɩɩbo,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: la pʋg-kãngã wã,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a manesmã sẽn pa sõmb yĩngã,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a ra yeta a sɩda t’a wa rɩk a rɩɩbã ragendẽ wã.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A sẽn da minim n maan dẽ wã,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: daar a ye,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: rao wã sũur sẽn da pa noom,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: n da pa noom baa bilfu,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a yãka yam n na n yi zakẽ wã la a bas a pagã be.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A yãka yam t'a pa na n dig a pagã ye,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a na n yiime la a bas zakã fasɩ.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A yika yibeoog pĩnd n sɩng kẽna.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A yãka yam tɩ wĩntoogã sã n lʋɩ la a na n yãase.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Zĩigã sẽn wa n sobge,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a kosa zĩig n na n gãande.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Rao a ye n deeg-a sãand a zakẽ.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: La ka,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a gãag soabã paga,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a sẽn wa n segl a mengã rɩɩb n sa,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: a boola a sɩdã n yeel-a :
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: « Hey,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: f bee yɩng la »?
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Tɩ sɩdã sak tɩ n-ye.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: « Bɩ f wa.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Mam saa m ragende.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Wa loog n segl f rẽnda »!
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A vẽk-n-beoog yibeoogo,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: rao wã sẽn da yi n bas a zakã yeela a menga :
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: «Ha,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: mam da pa mi tɩ neb n be kɛɛng n tar mam zu-loeesã buud ye.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Bãmb zu-loeesã pãng meng yɩɩd mam dẽ wã.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Rẽ wã,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: sẽn são ne-m yaa m lebg n kuili ».
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: A lebgame n bʋʋg a pagã tɩ bala yẽ ra yetame :
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: « M seglame n sa.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Wa rɩk f rɩɩbã »!
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Pag a ye wã yaool n yetame :
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: "Wa segl f rɩɩbã tɩ mam saa m dẽnda »!
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: Wakat ninga,
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: zu-loees n be n yɩɩd fo zu-loeesã.
title: 13 Rao a ye ne a paga

text: 14 Rao ne a pagba a yiibu.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Rao a ye n da tar pagb a yiibu.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: B roagdbã yiy ra zãra haɩ wʋsgo.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Yɩl n tɩ ges-b b tẽngẽ wã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: pagbã ra pɩʋʋgda kãgre.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: La kãgrã pʋg me,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: rũm-bees n da be be n tõe n yõk neda.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Pag a ye n wa n yik t'a na n tɩ gesa a roagdba.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A sɩdã mee tãnd teoog sẽn wõnd bao-bila,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: sẽn tõe n tus tɩ bilmi,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: n ning kʋɩleng sẽn ya bilf sẽn na yɩl t'a pagã tõog n kẽ n pag a meng pʋgẽ,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: la võy vʋʋsgã yĩnga.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Yaa ne bao-bil-kãng la pagã ra tõe n tɩ ges a roagdbã.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Baag sẽn tõe n tus baoorã tɩ bilim n da na n yãag-a t'a paam n ta a roagdbã nengẽ ne bãane.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A sẽn wa n kẽn n ta zĩig a ye,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: kãgrã sũ-nifẽ,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: we-rũms n seg-a n na n gɩdg a sorã.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Pagã sẽn da põg bao-bilã pʋgẽ wã boola baagã t'a rig we-rũmsã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: la talla woto tɩ b wa ta a roagdbã tẽngẽ.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: B sẽn ta,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: b laka kʋɩlen-bilã tɩ pagã paam n yi n na n vʋʋs n le gũud a lebgr daare.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Pagã ra mii vẽeneg tɩ ra yaa wẽnd maag baagã t'a paam n yi a sorã n pa paam zu-beed ye :
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: yẽ sã n dag pa beẽ,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a rag n da pa tõe n ta a roagdbã tẽngẽ ye.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Rẽ wã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: b sã n da segl rɩɩb n kõ pagã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: pipi,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a ra yãkda a rɩɩbã pedg n kõ baagã.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Wakat fãa,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: baagã ra rɩta a yam.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: B sã n da kõ-a ko-yũudum,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a ra rengdame n yãk n kõ baagã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: kɩtame tɩ ko-yũud pa tol n yõk baagã ye.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A sẽn wa n zĩnd a roagdbẽ wã n ta a daare,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a leba a tẽngẽ.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A sẽn lebã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a pʋg-to wã yeelame t'a ratame n kẽng n tɩ ges a roagdbã.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: La sorã woglem gill sẽn da pid ne we-rũm-bees yĩnga,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: rẽnd t'a ra paam bũmb sẽn na sõng-a t'a paam n ta ne bãane.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A sɩdã maana a sẽn da maan bũmb ning n kõ pag a ye wã n ko-a.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Teoog sẽn wõnd bao-bila,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: tɩ tõe n tus tɩ bilmi,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: n tar kʋɩleng sẽn ya bilfu,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: sẽn na yɩl t'a pagã tõog n kẽ n pag a meng pʋgẽ,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: la tar võy vʋʋsgã yĩnga.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A kɩtame tɩ baag ning sẽn da yãag a ye wã yãag-a.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: B sẽn ta wã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: b sã n kõ pagã rnb fãa,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a ra pa kõt baagã baa fʋɩ.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: B sã n da kõ-a ko-yũudum,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: a ra pa kõt baagã bũmb ye.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Baagã yaool n da yãag-a-la sõmb n maan a sẽn datã fãa !
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: B sẽn wa lebgdẽ wã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: n wa ta kãgrã pʋga,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: we-rũmsã pẽnega bao-bilã n na n gɩdg a sore.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Pagã sẽn da põg bao-bilã pʋgẽ wã boola baagã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: n bool-a n konge :
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: baagã pa wa fãag-a ye.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: A ra bas-a lame la yẽ me rɩk a sor n looge.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: We-rũmsã wãaga bao-bilã,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: n sak pagã n wãbe,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: bala a ra pa sak n pʋɩ a rɩɩbã ne a baagã ye,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: tɩ rẽ kɩt tɩ baagã ra lʋɩ,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: taoor n na n bao bũmb n dɩ.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: F sã n dut f ye,
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: f kiida f ye.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: Dɩt m ye kiida m ye.
title: 14 Rao ne a pagba a

text: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Solem-kãngã gomda ninsaal ne rũms sʋk vɩɩm sẽn ya to yelle.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Ninsaal yamã yɩɩda rũmsã fãa rẽnda,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: rẽ yĩnga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: daar a yembre,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: weoogã rũms sogla taab n maan tigsga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: n na n ges b sẽn tog n zã b mens to-to ninsaal taoore,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: t'a pãng pa ta bãmba,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: la wakat fãa a tõogda bãmba.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Tigsgã wakato bõnyẽeg yeelame :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Ninsaala,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: ba a tar yam,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: a pãng pa ta maam ye.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Rẽnd mam sã n tõog n gom ne ninsaala,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: m tõe n kɩtame t'a pa a zĩigẽ ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: ninsaal ra rabda weoog ne a peoog la a kutoaaga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: n na n tɩ bao tãmbɛgd n kõ a no-bi.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: A sẽn ta weoogẽ wã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: nif kamsg pugẽ,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: a yãa bõnyêega.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Bõnyẽeg sok-a lame :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Yaa foo la a ninsaal bɩ »?
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Tɩ ninsaal leoke :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « N-ye,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: yaa maam la a ninsaala ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Tõnd tagsdame tɩ fo yamã waooga wʋsgo,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: la rũndã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: yaa mam pãngã n be taoore.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Ninsaala,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: rũndã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: ne m pãngã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: m na n kʋ-f-la ne f yamã fãa » !
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Tɩ ninsaal leoke :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « La mam ra pa mi rẽ tiir wɛ.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: M pa segl m menga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: m leb n pa zã bũmb me n wa !
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Sɩd yĩnga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: m sã n da bãngẽ la tiiri,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: m da na seglẽ m menga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: la woto wã ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Bõ »,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: bõnyẽeg sẽn yeele,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: " m saka-me.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Kẽng n tɩ segl f meng la f lebg n wa.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Rũndã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: sẽn be mam yamẽ yaa m na lub-fu ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Ninsaal pa mi a sẽn na n maan bũmb ning ye,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: la bõnyẽeg togsd-a lame n dɩdgdẽ mosã :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Haya,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: haya wɛ.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Kẽng n tɩ segl f meng n lebg n wa !
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: mam gũud-f lame ?.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: La ninsaal yeela bõnyẽega :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « La mam zoeta m na n wa lebg n wa hal ka n pa mik-f ye ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Tɩ bõnyẽeg leoke :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Kuili,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: tʋg n segl f meng n lebg n wa mik-m ka ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Ninsaala :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Ayo !
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: mam pʋg pa peel ne-f ba bilfu.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: M zoeta m wa lebg n wa ka n pa mik-f ye ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: A ra zãada wĩiri,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: n yeel-a :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Fo sã n da na n sakẽ lame,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: mam da sẽbdẽ-la foom ne wĩ-kãngã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: rẽ m kõtẽ-la sɩd tɩ m mikd-f lame ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Mam sẽn dat tɩ f mik-ma yĩnga,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: m sakame tɩ f sẽb-ma ».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Ninsaal manegame n sẽb-a kãnkãe ne tɩɩga.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: A sẽn sẽb-a n sa,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: bõnyẽeg yeelame :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Kuil la f wa».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Tɩ ninsaal yeele :
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: « Mam pa le baood n na n kuil n tɩ segl m meng la m wa ye».
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: A rɩka kutoaagã a sẽn da tar n na n fiu tãmbɛgdã n pãb bõnyẽegã zugu.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Bõnyẽeg pa tar tẽeb ne a meng fãagr ye,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: yẽ la b sẽn sẽbã la.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Bõnyẽeg sẽn wa n sobge,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: ninsaal loka wĩyã la a rʋ tɩɩgã.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Woto mosã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: bõnyẽeg wa n vʋʋgame,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: n baood ninsaal n pa ne-a ye.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Ninsaal sẽn be yĩngrã,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: a kaooga willa,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: t'a sẽn kaoog willã maan bʋrga.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Rabeem kẽe bõnyẽeg t'a zoe n kẽ weoogã.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Daar-n-kãng tɛka,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: rũmsã kɩsa sɩd tɩ ninsaal yamã yɩɩda bãmba.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: Rẽ daar tɛka,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: rũng sã n yã ninsaala,
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: sẽn be ne-a yaa a sɩng zoeese.
title: 15 Ninsaala ne rũmsi

text: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Rotã sẽn tar sug-moosã yĩnga,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: bãn-poak taba sugrã ne lalgã sʋk wakat fãa.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: koambã noga raad la ra-sab n maan saag buudu,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: n sɩng roogã gilgr n na n yiis bãn-poaka.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: No-raoog sẽn wʋm kibarã pĩndã,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: a yeela zakã rũms a taabã tɩ b wa tao-tao n wa ges koambã sẽn maand bũmb ningã tɩ sã n pa rẽ b tõe n wa waa ne yel-wẽn-bɛda,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: tɩ b na n wa kʋʋ bãn-poaka.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Pʋg-yãan-bãad meng n da be roog ning koambã sẽn da rat n tɩ yiisẽ bãn-poakã n gãe.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: No-raoog yeela bʋʋga :
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: « Kẽng n tɩ ges koambã sẽn maand bũmb ningã,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: tɩ b na n waa ne yel-beedo ».
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Bʋʋg yeelame :
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: « Ayo,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: bas koambã .
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Pa yell sẽn pak tõnd ye ».
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Tɩ no-raoog leoke :
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: « maan gũusgu,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: sẽn pak bãn-poak mosã wã tõeeme n wa lebg tõnd yell n wʋm-d sõmbo ».
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Roogã pʋgẽ,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: waood n da tar pʋg-yãan-bãadã wʋsgo.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: A ra yõgna bugum n wootẽ.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Koambã ra tara kãnkãre,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: n dɩk n sẽgemd sugrã ne lalgã sʋk n zoet n gilimd roogã,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: sẽn na yɩl n maan bʋʋr tɩ bãn-poakã yi.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Saag n da sẽg sugrã zugu.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Koambã sẽn zoet n gilimd roogã maaname tɩ saagã lʋɩ bugmẽ wã.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Roogã yõka bugum.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Pʋg-yãangã pa tall pang sẽn sek a na paam a meng n yi ye.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Ned sẽn yaa kaseng sã n ki,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: kõo kũumã no-raoogo.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Wakat-kãnga no-raoog yeela bʋʋga :
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: « ade,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: mos yellã taa tõnd me ».
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: No-raoog sɩd neeme n yɩɩda :
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: a ya kʋdre n le ne yɩɩga.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: A vɩɩ ne ninsaalba n mi b manesem-dãmba.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: La bʋʋgã yẽ sẽn vɩ yɩng la a ya yãagã,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: a pa n yel-beed sẽn wat ye.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: Sɩd yɩ woto,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: tɩ reng n wa yõk no-raoog n looge,
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: n tɩ wa tall bʋʋg n looge.
title: 16 No-raoogo ne bʋʋga

text: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b rol-f beem.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Wakat ninga f maanda neer tɩ b rol-f beem.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: weoog bug-kẽeng n da na n dɩẽ gomtɩɔɔgo.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Sɩd me,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: gomtɩʋʋg pa tʋʋl ye,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: tɩ weoogã bugum yaool n da rɩt n wat tao-tao.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Ninsaaɩ sẽn yã tɩ gomtɩʋʋg ra bee yell pʋgẽ wã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a rɩk a raoog n dɩgl tẽnga,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: la gomtɩʋʋgã rʋʋ raoogã tɩ ninsaaɩ rɩk-a n tɩ ning ɩɩgg yokẽ.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Gomtɩʋʋg yeela ninsaala :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « M pʋʋsd-f-la bark wʋsg f sẽn yiis-m yel-to-kãngã pʋgẽ wã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Sigr saag sã n Iʋɩ,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: f sã n wa loogd ka n na n tɩ bʋde,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: m na bãng n pʋʋs-f bark f sẽn maan-mã yĩnga».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Sɩd me sigr saag sẽn lʋɩ bala,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: rao wã kẽnga ne a pag weoogẽ n na n tɩ bʋd ki.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A sẽn wa n ta tɩɩg ning a sẽn da saglẽ gomtɩʋʋgã sɛɛga a yeelame :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Hey,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: m zoa !
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: m waame».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Tɩ gomtɩʋʋg leoke :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Pẽnege ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Ninsaaɩ sẽn pẽneg yokã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: gomtɩʋʋg sẽnesa a ninẽ wã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Rao wã nin muma woto t'a pa le tõog n ta weoogẽ wã ye.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Ad a sẽn pʋʋs-a bark to-to Ne sũ-sãanga,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: rao wã yeela a pagã :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « D lebg n kuili.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Fo yãame ?
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A wẽe mam ninã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: M na n tɩ,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: maana bõe weoogẽ wã tɩ m sã n pa le neẽ ?
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Wa,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: d leb yiri ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Sorã zugu,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: b sega nameoongo.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Nameoong sok-b lame :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Yaa bõe n paam yãmba »?
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Rao wa ,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: leokame n yeele :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Yaa gomtɩʋʋg n sãam m nini ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: La yẽ sẽn maanã ne gomtɩʋʋg sẽn lebs-a wã kibare a wilgame.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Tɩ nameoong yeele :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Aoo,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: sã n yaa woto,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: mam tõe n kõ-f-la tɩto,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: mam tõeeme tɩ f ninã puki.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: La mam sã n puk fo ninã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: yaa bõe la fo me na n rol-ma »?
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Sɩdã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: mam na n maan-f-la neere,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: fo sã n na n puka mam ninã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Sẽn na yɩl tɩ f yam gãande »,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: rao wa sẽn Ieok n paase,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « ad mam sẽn na n togs foom :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: maam,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: m gʋʋnda noose.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Fo sã n puk mam ninã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: mam na n kõo foo m no-bi wã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Kom sẽn tar foo wakat ning fãa,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: mam na n kõ-f-la no-bi,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: rẽ f paamdame n dɩ ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Woto wã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: nameoong yeela rao wã t'a gãand zãmbɛɛla.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A zomba rao wã n na n tɩp-a :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a tʋbsa kolkood rao wã ninẽ la a pib a pɛgsã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Rao wã nin pukame t'a pagã yas yɛɛ n pa mi a sẽn maand a soab ye.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Rao wã nin sẽn puk bala,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: la a sẽn gãd nameoong karse :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « M na n maan-f-la wala gomtɩʋʋg sẽn maan ne maamã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: » rao wã sẽn yeele.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Fo sã n maan ned sõm a soab rond-f-la beem ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A wẽooga nameoong n gʋs a pɛgsã kõbd fãa gilli.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: tɩ nameoong ra pa leb n tõe meng n mams yɩkr ye.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A pa kʋ-a yaa sɩda,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: la a bas-a-la beell weoogẽ wã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Wakat kãnga,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: nameoong ra pa leb n mi a sẽn da na n maan to-to ning n dɩ ye :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: sã n yaa ne sẽn segdã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a ra yɩgdame n tʋgd n baood a rɩɩo,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: la mosã wã a pɛgsã pa leb n tar kõbd ye,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: t'a pa le tõe meng n yɩk ye.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A sɩd ra kẽngame n na n tɩ bao bũmb n dɩ la a ra ka yã ye.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Sẽn pa zãr wʋsg ne a sẽn beẽ wã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: kʋɩlg n da be be,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: t'a kẽng kʋɩlgã noor n na n tɩ bao n dɩ.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A yãa kuri,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: tɩ kurã yeel-a :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Bõe yĩnga,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: tɩ pĩnda,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: mam sã n da yã foo f ra yɩkdame,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: tɩ mosã fo pa leb n tõe n yɩke »?
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Mam maana rao sõm la rao-kãng rola maam a woto :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a gʋsa m pɛgsã kõbd zãnga.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Yaa rao wã n maan-m woto ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Tɩ kur leoke :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Kaanẽ,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: bũmb kae n dɩtẽ ye,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: la kʋɩlgã poore,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: rɩɩb bee be nebã fãa yĩnga.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Wa zomb maam.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: M na n dugame n tall-f n dʋʋg kʋɩlgã tɩ f tɩ paam n dɩ ».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Nameoong zomba kuri.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Kur kẽe koomã n dug ne nameoong a poorã zug a na n tall-a n dʋʋg kʋɩlgã.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A sẽn ta,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: nameoong sɩd paama rɩɩbo ;
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: rɩɩbã ra bee sõma.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Rasem a yopoe bal pʋgẽ,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a kõbdã zãng le pusame.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Nameoong sẽn paam a pɛgsã yɛsã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a boola kuri :
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: « Bõ,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: fo maana maam neere.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Mam pa mi m sẽn na n maan bũmb ning n dol-f ye,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: la mam tara zaka:
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: m na n dɩk-f lame n tɩ wĩnig-f m zakã rãmba,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: f sẽn maan-m neerã yĩnga».
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Kur sokame:
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: «Bõe la m tog n maane» ?
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Nameoong gãandame,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: kur zomba a poorã zug tɩ b yɩke.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Nameoong yukame n kaoose,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: n zãag zĩig sõma.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: A sẽn wa n yã zĩig sẽn yaa pĩig kugr gilli,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: a bãnegame,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: n lebg a meng n bas kur t'a lʋɩ pĩigã zugu.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Yãmb sẽn ne tɩ kur paokã tara sẽnesmã,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: yaa nameoong sẽn maan-a wã n wa ne rẽ.
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: Wakat ninga,
title: 17 f maanda neer tɩ b

text: f maanda neer tɩ b lebs-f wẽenga.

text: 18 Soaamba ne katre.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: m ba soaamb ne m ba katr ra gõoda weoogẽ.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: B gõobã pʋgẽ,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: b yãa bõnyẽeg koamba,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: kom-neeba,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: sẽn da gãe n gõe.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: B ra yaa b yiibu.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: M ba soaamb yeela katre :
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: « Fo yãa rũm-kãensã?
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: yaa m ba bõnyẽeg koamba.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Wa,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: d na n kʋ-b lame!
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: D na n dɩk-b lame n kʋ »!
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Bõnyẽ-bi wã ra bee tɩ-kẽeng tẽngre.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Soaamb vilimda tɩɩgã kudg n sul bõnyẽegã biig a korgẽ.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: M ba katr yɛl sẽn pa tũud tɩrgã,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: a sẽn dɩk bíigã,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: a maaname t'a zugã wẽ tɩɩgã sɛɛga.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Bõnyẽegã biig kiime t'a rɩk-a kɩɩng n sul a korgẽ.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: B yiibã loogame,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: la b sẽn ta taoor bilf bala,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: b sega bõnyẽ-yãangã.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: B sẽn yã bõnyẽ-yãangã,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: soaamb n yɩ pipi n yeele :
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: « Ha,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: bõnyẽega !
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: tõnd da baooda foom !
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Tõnd da gõodame n yã f koambã ka B ra yãbdame.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Tõnd nog-b lame n na n wa kõ-fo».
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Bõnyẽeg pʋʋs-b-la barka la a yeele :
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: « Yiis-y-ba ».
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: M ba soaamb yiisa a rẽnda.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Bõnyẽ-bilã ra pa yi n sa la a wudg n na n bʋʋg a ma ye.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: M ba katr ra pa yet tɩ bũmbu a ra pa yẽrgde.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Yẽ n pa yiisd a bõnyẽ-bíla,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: yẽ n pa yet bũmb me.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Tɩ soaamb yeele :
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: « Haya.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Fo tog n yiisa bõnyẽeg biigã n kõ a ma ».
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Tɩ katr yaa sɩɩ.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Sẽn yɩ bílfu,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: a sẽn bãng tɩ yellã rat n lebga kɛgengã,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: a suii a nug a korgã pʋga.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: A yiisa biigã,
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: n lob-a zĩig zãorg la a sɩng zoeese.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: Hal rũndã a ket n zoetame.
title: 18 Soaamba ne katre

text: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: pondr yeela vũnuvũugu,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: t'a sã n data,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: zĩiga sa n wa yaa sõma,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: b tõe n tũu taab n yi n gõ.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Woto wã,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: daar a ye zĩigã sẽn yaa sõma,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: pondr yeelame t'a na n tɩ gesa a reem-dãmba,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: tɩ vũnuvũug yi ne-a n na n kẽnge,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: n zomb a poorã.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: B sẽn ta tɩ b na n kõ-b rɩɩbo,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: pondr yɩɩ pipi n zĩndi.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Vũnuvũug da ratẽ lame n zĩnd a sɛɛgẽ,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: la a yeel-a lame :
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: « Ha,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: m zoa,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: maan sugr la f ti.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: rɩgl f bendrã »,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: vũnuvũug pɛgsã sẽn maand bʋrg wʋsgã yell la a sẽn gomdã »,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: « rẽ mosã,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: f tõe n wa rɩɩme ».
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Vũnuvũug sã n lebg n wa zaoonde,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: a pɛgsã le sɩngda bʋrg maaneg tɩ pondr le yeel-a t'a kẽng n tɩ rɩgl a bendrã kɛɛng la a yaooɩ n wa rɩ.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: La sẽn yaa vũnuvũug pɛgsã n da maand bʋʋrã a woto wã,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: a pa tõog n tɩ « rɩgl a bendrã kɛɛng ye ».
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Yɩɩ woto tɩ pondr rɩ,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: rɩɩbã zãng n pa kell-a ba fʋɩ ye.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Loogrã wakat wa n taame,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: vũnuvũug ra ket n pa paam bũmb sẽn na dɩ ye,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: a sẽn da yaool n tũ pondr n kẽngã ra yaa rɩɩbã yĩnga.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Sẽn wa n beẽ,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: vũnuvuug wa n yeela pondre :
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: « bõ ondre nindaarẽ mam sẽn yãag foom f reem-tẽngã tɩ ra yɩ sõma wã,.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: rũndã,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: mam kota foom tɩ f wa yãag-m tɩ m tɩ ges m reem-dãmba».
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: B sẽn ta,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: vunuvuug reem dãmbã segla rɩɩb sẽn yaa sõma n kõ-b tɩ na n naag taab n dɩ.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Pondr tʋgd n peka a nusã,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: la rẽ poore,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: yɩl n ta rɩɩbã zĩigẽ,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: a le rɩgend-b-la tẽnga.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Tɩ vũnuvũug yeele :
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: « Ayo,
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: kal tɩ f lebge !
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Ges fo nusã »!
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Tɩ pondr le lebe.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Talla woto tɩ vũnuvũug rɩ rɩɩbã zãnga tɩ pondr pa tol n tõog n pek a nusã ye.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: Vũnuvũug roka a samdã pondr zugu.
title: 19 Pondre ne vũnuvũugu

text: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ baaga.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Daar a yembre,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: weoogẽ baag ra gõodame.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: A taa tẽng a ye zags kudga.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: A taa roog a ye sɛɛgẽ n yã baaga.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Hey,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: fo yʋʋr la a bõe »?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Maam,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: m yʋʋr la a baaga ».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Bõe ?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: fo me ?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: La f vʋɩ ka »?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « N-ye ».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Mam datẽ lame tɩ fo wa ne maam.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: D na n tɩ vɩɩmda weoogẽ,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: la weoogẽ vɩɩm yaa toogo.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Kal tɩ f tall yam bilfu,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: sã n pa rẽ,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: f pa tõe n vɩɩnd be ye ».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Yir baag yeelame :
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Sã n yaa rẽ,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: yell ka be ye.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Mam tara yam.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Wakat fãa,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: mam sẽn tar yam nins sõorã sẽn pa waoog la piig la a yiibu !
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Yam piig la a yiibu,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: mi tɩ pa paood ye »!
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Kiuug a ye loogr poore,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: b sẽn wa n yi daar a ye n gõodẽ,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: la saagã sẽn sɩng niibu.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Tɩ b tɩ kẽ tãng bokẽ n na n sool saagã.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: B sẽn kẽ bokã pʋg bal n sa,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: la m ba katr sẽn ta.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Yir baag sẽn yã katrã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: rabeem kẽ-a lame t'a lʋɩ n gãand a naoẽ wã.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Tɩ katr yeele :
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Aoo,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: y yibeoogo,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: y keemame ?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Yaa bõe la y maand ka »?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « D waa n soola saaga».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Aoo,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: rẽ yaa sõma wʋsgo !
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Bala zaamẽ tɛkã mam sẽn gõodã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: m nan pa paam bũmb n dɩ ye.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: La yãmb y yiibã kell n zemsa mam sẽn da ratã ».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Saagã ra niime n yooge,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: tɩ wéoogẽ baag sok yir baaga :
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Ade.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Wakat taame.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Fo yeela maam tɩ wakat fãa fo yam-dãmb sõor sẽn pa waoog la piig la a yiibu.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Wakat taame tɩ fo yiis a ye n paam n yi bog-kãngã pʋga »!
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: La yir baag yeèlame tɩ mosã wã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: wakat kãngã a sẽn da be zĩig ningã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: yam a yiib tãa n da ket ne-a.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « La yam-kãens a yiibã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: yaa bʋse »?
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Sẽn ket ne maam yaa m rʋʋdem yaa sãaga.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Ad yam nins sẽn ket ne-ma »!
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: We-baag yeelame :
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Maam yẽ miime bal tɩ katr rat n yõka tõnd n wãbe,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: la m na n maana m sẽn tõe n põse ».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Katre !
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: we-baag sẽn yeele.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Bõn-dẽgd kãngã pa tõe n wʋm fo sẽn yetã ye.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Yaa sãana.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: A ra vɩɩ ne ninsaalba la yaa maam n wa ne-a ka.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: La a tara kẽn buud sẽn pa wõnd a taaba,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: tɩ fo sã n yã bɩ na n maan-f laad wʋsgo ».
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Bɩ a kẽn kẽn-kãng buud tɩ m gese »,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: katr sẽn yeele.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: We-baag sẽn wa yet a ye wã t'a kẽnã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: a walm-a lame n yeele :
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Zẽk f zʋʋrã n kẽnd n saoodẽ »!
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: T'a sɩd maan boto.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: A sẽn da kẽndã,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: a ra zẽkda a zʋʋrã n nakd a zugã.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Sɩd ra maanda laado.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: A sẽn maan na-yakem a wãna,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: katr yeelame :
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: « Sekame,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: m yãame,
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: m yãame.
title: 20 Yir baag ne weoogẽ

text: Lebg n wa,

text: Bi-bɩɩgã leokame :
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: « Rẽ pa yell ye.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Rẽ pa sek yãbr ye »!
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: A goma ne zĩnã n yeel-a :
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: « Fo ratame tɩ b lebs f zoobdã b zĩigẽ wã.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Rẽ tõeeme,
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: a yaa f sẽn na n tõog n yẽes f noa wã vũgs fo sẽn kẽn n wa tãag ka wã ».
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Zĩnã sɩnga kẽn la a yẽesd a nao wã vũgs ne nugu.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Rẽ poore a wẽnemdame n bʋʋg nebã a yiibã sẽn da gũud-a wã.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: A sẽn ta b sɛɛgẽ,
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: a le neeme tɩ yẽ nao wã vũgs le rɛgame :
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: nao wã vũgs pa tõe n yẽes ye,
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: zoobdã sẽn wõrsã pa tõe n tong ye.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Zĩna sẽn kong pãngã a loogame.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Wakat ninga,
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: yãag tõe n yiisa a ba yɛl pʋgẽ.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: « Yãag nin peelame la b pa ne yɩɩg ye.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: Nin-kẽem nin pa peel ye la a nee ne a yam ».
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: La wakat ning me,
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: yãas nee nin-kẽemb sẽn pa ne.
title: 24 Rao a ye ne a biiga

text: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne gãeenga.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Ma-biis a naas n da be zak a ye pʋga.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Pipi soabã ra tara pagb a yiibu.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Yiib-n-soabã ne tãab-n-soabã pag a yembr - yembre,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: ti naas-n-soabã,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: b yao-zʋʋgã,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: ra pa tar pag ye.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Bʋko daar a ye,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: ma-biisã sʋka a ye n ki.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Sẽn da ki-a wã yaool n da tara pag a ye.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: fo sã n ki,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: buudã n deegd f pagbã.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Ned ning sẽn da tar-a pag a ye wã tag n da tata a to n paase.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Sẽn da tar a pagb a yiiba me ra tata taab n soaba.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Bãmb ned ba a ye da pa rat n bas tɩ sẽn pa tar-a pagã soab rɩk pag ye.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: B rɩka daarã tõr n na n bao yellã tɩɩm,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: kasem-dãmbã la sẽn da pa rat n bas tɩ b yao-zʋʋgã rɩk pʋg-kõorã la.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Tẽnga gãeeng waa b nengẽ zakẽ wã.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: B rɩka yell ning b sẽn tigim taab n baood a tɩɩmã n kongdẽ wã n togs-a :
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: d ma-bi-taag a ye n ki.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Kasmã,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: yẽ ra zoe n tara pagb a yi,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: n dat tãab-n-soaba.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Sẽn pʋgd-a yẽ wã sẽn da zoe n tar pag a ye wã,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: tata yiib-n-soaba.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Yao-zʋʋgã ra pa tar pag ye,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: la a ma-biis a yiibã ra pa rat n bas pʋg-kõorã n kõ-a ye.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Ad gãeengã sẽn yeele :
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: « Sẽn zoe n tar-a pagb a yi n dat tãab-n-soabã rata kũum.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Sẽn zoe n tar-a pag a ye n dat yiib-n-soabã rata zabre.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Pipi soabã sã n pa rat kũum,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: a pa na n dɩk pag a tãab-n-soab ye.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Yiib-n-soabã sã n pa rat zabre,
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: a pa na n dɩk pag a yiib-n-soab ye.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Rẽnd d na n basa paga n ko yao-zʋʋga sẽn pa tar pagã ».
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: Gãeeng n tõog n maneg yell sẽn da wõnd a pa tar tɩɩm.
title: 25 Ma-biis a naas ne

text: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Bõaas a ye n da me a roog sor noore.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Bõaasã ra yaa zoanga.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: A ra gʋlsa yɩɩll sẽn yete :
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: « Sẽn maan-a neer maana a meng neere,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: sẽn maan-a wẽeng maana a meng wẽenga ».
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: A sẽn da yaa bõaas yĩnga,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: n yaa zoang la a ra yɩɩnd yɩɩn-kãngã wã yĩnga,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: sẽn da loogd-bã fãa ra kõt-a-la bũmbu.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Rao a ye n ne rẽnda tɩ zabd-a,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: t'a maan maas sẽn zẽne,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: n tũud sorã n loogdẽ n dɩk-a n kõ zoangã,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: sẽn na yɩl ta wãb n ki tɩ sa.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Rẽ a pa lebd n tõog n yɩɩl yɩɩllã la a bõos ye.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: A sẽn deeg maasã,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: zoangã rɩgl-a-la kɛɛnga n wa rɩk n zã n kuili.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Rao ning sẽn kɩɩm-a maasã sẽn zẽnã koamb ra karemda lekolle.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Daar a ye,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: b sẽn yi Iekollã n kuiisẽ,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: saagã sɩnga niib wʋsgo,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: tɩ b kẽ zoangã roogẽ n na n sool saagã.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: « Bõaasa »,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: b sẽn yeel-a,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: « tõnd pa tar bũmb sẽn na rɩ ye ».
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Zoangã rɩka maasã kom-kãensã baaba wã sẽn da kõ-a wã n kõ koambã tɩ b na n yiis b kom.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: Koambã sẽn wa n ta yiri,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: b pʋsã yikame n zabd zabr menga.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: B baaba sok-b lame :
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: « Yaa bõe n maane »?
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: B yãbdame la b gomd n yetẽ tɩ b sẽn wa n yit lekollã n watẽ wã,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: saag n ling-b tɩ b tɩ sool zoangã roogẽ la,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: kom sẽn da tar bãmb yĩnga,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: zoangã kõo bãmb maasa.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: B ba wã bãnga zĩig pʋgẽ tɩ ra yaa maas ning a sẽn da kõ zoangã la a rɩk n kõ koambã.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: T'a na n yãbe,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: la a bãngame tɩ zoangã yɩɩllã yaa sɩda :
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: « Fo sã n maan neere,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: f maana f menga.
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: F maan wẽenga,
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: f maana f menga ».
title: 26 Rao a ye ne bõaasa

text: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a yiib kibare.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: M na n goma pag a ye ne a koamb a yiib kibare.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Koambã yʋy la a Pok la a Raoogo.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Tɩ ra yaa kĩnkĩrsi.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog n da ya bi-ribla t’a Pok ra yaa bi-pugla.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Sẽn beẽ n beẽ,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: pagã wa n nonga a bi-pugl a Poko,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: n kisg a bi-riblã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog sẽn da maan bũmb ning fãa,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: ba t'a ra maan.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: bũmb sẽn ya sõma,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ma wã ra pẽsgd-a-la ne nug n lalle,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ bala sã n yaa ne yẽ,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a Pok bal n da tõe n maan bũmb sẽn sõmbe.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: La ne rẽ fãa,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Wẽnnaam beoog sẽn vẽeg daar fãa,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a Raoog ra paamda pãng tẽngã pʋgẽ n paasdẽ.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Nebã fãa ra nong-a-la a tʋʋmã yĩnga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a sẽn nong n sõng a to wã yĩnga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Sɩd yĩngã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: nebã fãa ra nong-a lame.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Daar a ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a kengame n tɩ wʋr mood n na n kõ a zak rãmba.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A sẽn wa n kuiisẽ,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: nin-kẽem a ye n kos-a t'a kõ-a mood bilf t'a yõgen a bugum.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Zĩig pʋgẽ,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a raoog kõ-a-la moodã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Nin-kẽemã sẽn da pa mi a sẽn da na n dol a maan-neerã to-to ningã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a rɩka noaag n kõ-a.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog pʋʋs-a-la bark la a tall noaagã n kuili.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Sẽn wa n beẽ noaagã loba gɛla,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ no-bi-neeb weke.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Noaagã ra lebga arzak bũmb n kõ a Raoogo.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ma wã ra pa rat arzag-kãng lae-lae ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: bala a rata a Raoog ne wẽenga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rẽnd a yeela a Raoog t'a kʋ a noaagã n tɩ koos raagẽ.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog sɩd maana woto,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ bala a ra pa kɩɩsd b sẽn yet t'a maan bũmb ning ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: sẽn yɩɩd fãa,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ma wã sẽn da yet a maane.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ma sã n da yeel-a :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: « Tʋm f nug bog-kãngã pʋgẽ n yõk bũmb n kõ-ma » a ra maandame,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: ba a ra mi tɩ bũmb n tõe n maan-a.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rẽnd a Raoog kʋʋ a noaagã n tɩ koos raagẽ.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rao a ye n wa n kos noaagã lɛnga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A sẽn lembe a mikame tɩ ra yaa noogo.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A sẽebã ra yɩ sõma.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: T'a kos a Raoog a noaagã sẽn sẽ wã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ra yeel-a lame tɩ badaarã a ra pa tar ligd ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ la a vẽk-n-beoogo a ra na n yaoome tɩ Wẽnd sã n sake.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog sẽn da pa tõdgd ned bũmb kũunã yĩnga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a kõ-a-la a noaagã la a lebg n kuilif A ma wã zab-a-la sõma tɩ bala sã n yaa ne yẽnda,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: ned pa tõe n tɩ koos noaaga (rẽ me no-yɛng bala !)
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: n kẽ be n dɩk n kõ samd ye :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: « Rẽ pa tõe ye !
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Fo tõog n maana wãn woto »?
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A vẽnega fãa n togse,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: la a ma ra pa rat n wʋm ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A vẽk-n-beoogo,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: rao wã sẽn da rɩk noaagã lebgame n wa kõ-a wed-mo-neere,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: bala a Raoog nin-nonglmã ra sãag-a lame.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: T'a Raoog reeg wed-mo-kãnga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ma wã ra yãka yam n na n sɩbg wed-moaagã vɩɩm tɩ rẽ yɩ sabab n keng a Raoog vɩɩmã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A yeelame tɩ b karg naan-gilg sẽn pa tar noore,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tl,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: bala b na n mee ro-gilga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: sẽn ka kʋɩlenga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: n pag wed-moaagã be.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rẽ,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: wed-moaagã yĩnga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: b pa le baood zãnd a to bɩ mood yas ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rẽ la a Raoog maan yã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A mee ro-gilga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ wed-moaagã be pʋgẽ,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: kʋɩleng kae,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: gãag zĩig kae.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: La,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: ne Wẽnd sõngre,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ Wẽnd n kõ-a rɩɩb n nobs-a,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: rasem a wae pʋgẽ wed-moaagã nobame n pusg roogã lalse.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Yɩɩ woto tɩ daar a ye yibeoogo,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: b mikame tɩ wed-moaagã ra bee yɩɩga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: tɩ roogã lalg a ye wã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Ma wã yeelame :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: « Tall weefã n kẽng Gãmbaaga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: naabã sẽn beẽ wã n tɩ kõ-a weefã ».
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog ra pa kɩɩsd b sẽn yet t'a maan lae-lae ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: sẽn yɩɩde,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ma sẽn yeel-a.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A yikame.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A yõka a weefã n dɩk Gãmbaag sore.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ma ra yãka yam n na n yãag-a bilfu,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: la sorã zugu a yãa neb sẽn loogd ne mo-kil n na n tɩ pil suga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Ma wã yeelame :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: « Fo pa le baood n na n kẽng ne wed-moaagã be ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Sẽn sõmb n yɩɩd yaa f rɩk wed-moaagã n tek ne mo-kill a ye n tʋk mo-killã n kẽng Gãmbaaga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: « Sɩd me,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a Raoog sã n da kẽng ne wed-moaagã a ra tõeeme n zomb-a,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: la ne mo-killã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: rɩlla a mengã tuke.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog sẽn sakd nana wakat fãa wã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a maana wala a ma wã sẽn yet a maan bũmb ningã :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a teka a wed-moaagã ne mo-killi n zɩ n loog Gãmbaaga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A sẽn ta Gãmbaaga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a tɩ yãa naabã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Naabã ra yaa zoanga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a pʋg-kẽemã ra yaa zoanga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: b ra pa tar koamb me ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog kosame n na n yã náabã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Naabã kɩtame t'a kẽ la a kos-a t'a kõ-a a moodã bilf t'a yõgen bugum.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog maana a sẽn yeelã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Bugmã sẽn yõgne,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: naab nin pukame.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Naab sũur yɩɩ noogo,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: t'a kos a Raoog t'a yãk moodã bilf n kõ a pʋg-kẽemã me tɩ yẽ me ra yaa zoanga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: la pagã me nin pukame.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Kɩtame tɩ naab reeg a Raoog tɩ lebg a biiga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: t'a Raoog vɩɩmd vɩ-noog be.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: La daar a ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a Raoog yeelame t’a rat n leba a ma nengẽ.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A lebgrã yĩnga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: naab kõ-a-la sẽn tõe n kõ buudã fãa :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: rap la pagb sẽn na n yãag-a ne rũms wʋsgo.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rẽ ra yaa a Raoog keoor sẽn da segde t'a rag n zɩ n maan ned wẽeng ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ra maanda neer bala.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A sẽn ta a yirã – ne sõgen damba sẽn dag n yaag a wa :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: pagb ra bee be,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: rap ra bee be n paas rũms wʋsgo - a Raoog ra lebga rakãagre.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ra pa rɩk a ma wã sɩbg-zaalã a sẽn da yãtã n ning a yamẽ ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ra ket n date lame n ges a ma wã yelle,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: ba ne nebã sẽn da sagend a t'a bas a ma t'a ya a nifẽ wã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ra pa kelgd sagl-kãens ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Yɩɩ woto t'a ra rat t'a ma wã ra leb n seglg rɩɩb ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: t'a ra leb n tʋm zakã tʋʋm ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: La a yeel pagba sẽn yaag b yẽ wã tɩ b reeg a ma zĩig n tʋm tʋʋm-bɛdã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Rẽ maaneg yɩ tao-tao :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a Raoog sẽn da yeel fãa ra maandame tɩ sãmbg kaẽ ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: La ne rẽ fãa,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: pagã sũur ra ket n pa noom ba bilf ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A sẽn yi daar a ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: sẽn pa zãr ne zaka,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ra yãa waaf sẽn kẽ bok pʋga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Tao-tao t'a kɩtame tɩ b bool a bi-ribl a Raoogo :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: t'a wa tʋʋll la a ra rɩk bũmb lae ye,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: t'a wa nug-zaala.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog yɩ tao-tao n ta.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A yeel-a lame t'a tʋm a nugã bokã pʋga :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ra yãa bũmb be n dat bũmbã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A Raoog tʋma a rɩʋtg nug bokã pʋga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: la yɩɩ yaeesg tɛkẽ ne pagã a biigã sẽn wa n yiis a nuga :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a nuga ra zera ne kĩn la wanzuri n tãag bãgdo.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A rɩka goabg nugã n tʋme.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Kell n yɩɩ bũn-yɛnga :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: le yɩɩ wanzuri n tɩ tãag bãoko.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: « Wã sɩd yaa rakãaglem »!
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: pagã sẽn yeel a menga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: T'a bool a bi-puglã - a sẽn da nong-a wʋsgã - n yeel-a tɩ yẽ me tʋm a nug bokã pʋga.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: La a sẽn ta,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a rag n pa yã n tʋm a nug bokã pʋg la waafã ke-a ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Zu-beedo,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: rũmbã kʋ-a lame.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Sɩd yĩngã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: bi-puglã ra nonga a ma-bi-raoogã.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Wakat fãa,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ra yeta a ma t'a ra kɩtdẽ t’a Raoog tʋmd tʋʋm-yaals ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A ra kogenda a ma-bi-raoogã,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: la a rag n zɩ n tõog n gom n fãag a Raoog a ma taoor ye.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: Yɩɩ woto tɩ pagã wẽnem yĩnga,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: bi-puglã ki.
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: A bi-puglã kũum poore,
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a ma wã toeema zʋg n dɩk zʋg-sõngo :
title: 27 Pag a ye ne a koamb a

text: a bãngame tɩ ned togame n nong a koamb fãa n wõneg taaba.

text: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Yi-kãad-paalg a ye n paam a pipi biiga,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: la a ra pa tar ligd sẽn sekd zu-lukrã maaneg ye.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Yɩɩ modgr tɩ biiga ba yi n na n kos tɩ nina ra sõng-a ne ligd t'a paam n da peosgo.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Tɩ woto bal la a ra tõe n paam n segl zu-lukrã sõmbo.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Tẽngã rap seda taab noor n na n lob ligd n dik n kõ bi-pɛɛlgã baaba.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: A sũur yɩɩ noogo,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: ta tõogame n paam peosg n da.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Yʋng sẽn ta,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: wagdr n kẽ zakẽ wã n zuk peosgã,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: la a sẽn wa n maag a meng n zukd peosga,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: a korg n yi a loaabẽ wã n lʋɩ.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Beoog sẽn vẽege,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: bi-pɛɛlgã ba yãa korg a pebsgã zĩigẽ.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: A sẽn pake,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: a yãa ligd sẽn sekd piis a naas raabo.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: A sẽn maan zu-lukrã,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: sɩd yɩɩ tigr menga.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Wagdrã meng zĩnda tigre wã,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: n sok rao wã :
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « Rẽ yĩnga fo bũmb pa menem »?
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « Ayo,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: mam bũmb pa menem ye ».
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « La fo zu-lukrã,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: fo maand-a-la ne piis a wãna »?
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « Rẽ wã,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: b yaa b naase ».
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « Sid yĩnga,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: kelg-m sõma »,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: wagdrã sẽn yeele,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « yaa maam n wa n zuk f peosgã,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: la mam korg n lʋɩ fo zakẽ wã ».
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « Fo korgo »?
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Rao wã sẽn yeel ne lingri,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: « ayo,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: mam pa yã rẽ bũud ye.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Mam da basa peosg a ye zaamẽ zaabr ka,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: m zakã pʋgẽ,
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: n yik yibeoogã n yã a naase.
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: Mam pa yã korg ye ».
title: 28 Wagdre ne a korgo

text: 29 Zoens a yiibu.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Zoens a yiib n da tũud taab n saagd zagsã n bõosdẽ,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: n kot rɩɩb sẽn na rɩ.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Daar a ye,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: yaames yĩnga,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: b yaasame t'a ye wã yeele :
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: « Tõnd bee namsg yĩng bala.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: D na n lʋɩɩ bulgã pʋg tɩ sa.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Bas n namsd woto wã,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: d sẽn kʋʋd d mens n são.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Wakat ninga,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: tond pa paamd dɩɩb meng ye,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: d pa mi d sẽn na n tɩ gãand zĩig ning meng ye,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: d pa mi ned ning meng sẽn na n yelg tõnd ye.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Sẽn sõmb n yɩɩd yaa d lʋɩ bulgã pʋg tɩ sa ».
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Zoang a ye wã sakame,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: tɩ b na n tũ taab n kẽng n tɩ bao bulg n lʋɩ.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: B sʋkã a ye wã da ratame n wẽg a to wã,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: n tek n dɩk kug-kẽeng sorã zugu.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Sẽn da rɩk-a kugrã yeelame :
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: « Maam n na n yɩ pipi n ʋɩ.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Fo sã n wʋm mam lʋɩɩsã bʋrga,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: bɩ f ra kaoos la fo me lʋɩ ye ».
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: La a pẽneg bulgã n bas kugrã tɩ Iʋɩ a mengã zĩigẽ :
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: « bum »!
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: La bʋrg a to pa maan n pʋgl ye.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: A sẽn lub kugrã bala,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: a lakame.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Zoang a ye wã tirame n yãas n gom ne a menga :
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: « Ay,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: mam na n basame n Iʋɩ nindaare ».
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Bʋrg ning tẽngã sẽn maanã ra wĩnig-a lame t'a ye wã ra pa kʋ a meng ye.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: B sẽn da yaa b yiibã,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: b sã n da paam kũun fãa,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: b ra segdame n pʋɩ.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Ned kam fãa ra tagsame t'a sã n da paam n ya a ye,
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: a sẽn paam fãa yɩta yẽ n so.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: Bõos-rãmb pa nong taab ye.
title: 29 Zoens a yiibu

text: 30 Rap a yiib ne wag-kẽenfo.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Rap a yiib n tũ taab n na n tɩ bao gɛla.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: B kẽname n kaoose,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: b maana daarã tõr n pa tol n yã gell a yembr meng ye.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: La ned a ye wã yãa wag-kẽenf sẽn gãe a bok pʋga.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A pa yeel a zoa wã t'a yãa bũmb ye.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A sẽn wa n na n yeel-a yaa tɩ bũmb ning sẽn da são ne-b yaa b kuili,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: tɩ bala b pa yã bũmb ye.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A ra tagsame t'a sa n pʋʋs a zoa wa wẽnd na taase,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: a ra na n lebga a ye n tɩ kʋ waafã la a vʋk a gɛlã zãnga.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Woto la a ra tagsda,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: la a zoa wã ra bãngame tɩ bũmb n da be n da yaa libsgu.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: B yiibã lebgame n kuil b tẽngẽ wã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Ned ning b sẽn da rat n wẽgã sẽn ta a zakẽ wã,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: a yãka yam n na n kẽng a ye wã zakẽ n tɩ gese a beeme bɩ.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A taa a zoa wã zakẽ la wala a sẽn da tẽedã,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: a ra ka be ye,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: tɩ bala a ra kẽngame n na n tɩ bao wag-kẽenfã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: T'a na n pʋg a nao.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Rẽ wakat t'a ye wã,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: ra taa waafã bokẽ,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: la a ra pa bãng a kʋʋb ye.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Tʋg n yaa waafã n da gãd yẽ n da vuud n dabd kʋɩlgẽ wã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A zoa wã sẽn ta wakat kãnga wã,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: zĩig pʋgẽ a bãnga bũmb ning sẽn da be.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A sɩnga zoeese,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: la wakat fãa a zoa wã sã n gãd moog bɩ tuugu,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: a ye wã rɩkda a larã n keeg a yẽgã,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: sẽn na yɩl n dok a sũurã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Talla woto tɩ waafã tar a rɩɩb vuub n na n tɩ kẽ koomẽ wã n dɩ.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Nedã sẽn be toogã pʋgẽ wã gãda tɩɩg willa,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: tɩ sẽn da pʋgd-a wã wa ta n keeg willã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: T'a gãd tuugu,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: t'a ye wã keeg tuugã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Yɩɩ woto tɩ waafã vu n ta kʋɩlgã noore.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Wakat kãnga,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: rao wã bãngame tɩ waafã ra na n kẽe koomã pʋga,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: tɩ rẽ ra tõe n kɩt t'a paam n kʋ a zoa wa nana-nana.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: T'a rɩk a ra-teoogã n na n zab ne waafã.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: La a tõogame n kʋ-a.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A zoa wã paamame n põse.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Ad yam-sõng b sẽn kõ nin-kãngã,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: tɩ rẽ daar tɛka,
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: bɩ a pa le rnaan yel-kãensã buud ye.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A ra ratame n wẽg a zoa n paame.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A ye wã pa bas-a ye.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: A kɩame tɩ rabeem kaseng kẽ-a n yaool n wa baas n fãag-a.
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne

text: Yaa woto la b sẽn yet tɩ « n kõ ned vẽenmã ».
title: 30 Rap a yiib ne
