text: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr kibare.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Nin-kẽem a yembr n wa n yik a zak pʋgẽ, n na n tɩ gõ weoogẽ.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La, a bi-bilf a yembr yikame, t’a na n tũ-a lame.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La, a ba wã tõdgame, t’a kõn tũ ye.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Tɩ bõe?
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: A paoodame, weoogã pʋg yaa gõose, koom kae me, n yũud ye.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La, a biigã tõdgame, n tũ-a n looge.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: B sẽn wa n ta we-raoogã pʋga, saag n kʋɩ, tɩ sebgã sɩng yikri.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: B zoe n tɩ kẽe tãng bokẽ, n na n sool saagã.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Mik bokã yaa m ba Weoognaab roogo.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: M ba Weoognaab sẽn wa n yi gõob n wa, a mikame t’a roogã pida ne rɩɩbo, t’a na n kɩdem ne sũ-noogo, n pʋd yɩɩll n yetẽ :
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: «Roog vũuda, roog vũuda, roog vũud tɩ m meng be yɩng n daeeda».
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Tɩ biigã leok-a :
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: «M pa sablem naaba, m pa zẽenem naaba, sã n pa beoogo, tõnd pa kuus ye.»
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: M ba Weoognaab sẽn wʋm dẽ, a kɩdmame, n zoe n maan wa kɩlomɛtr a yiibu.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Wakat-kãnga, la biigã yeel a ba wã :
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: «Yik tao-tao n dɩk yir sore».
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La nin-kẽemã yiime, t’a sũurã tar kiu, kiu, la a yetẽ :
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: «Weoognaab ye n da seg maam sorã zug ye ».
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La, m ba Weoognaab lebg n waame, n le sɩng yɩɩl n yetẽ :
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: «Roog vũuda, roog vũuda, roog vũud tɩ m meng be yɩng n gõodẽ.»
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Tɩ biigã leok-a yasa :
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: «M pa sablem naaba, m pa zẽenem naaba, sã n pa beoogo, tõnd pa kuus ye ».
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Sũ-noogã yĩnga, a Weoognaab sɩnga kɩdengo, la zoees yasa, n na n gilme.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Tɩ biigã tũnug m ba Weoognaab loogrã, n yi n dɩk sor n zoe n kuili.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: M ba Weoognaab sẽn wa n lebg n wa, a ra tẽedame t’a rɩɩbã ketame, t’a le sɩng yɩɩla, la ned ba a ye pa leokd-a ye.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: T’a kolg n na n lɩk n gese, la ned ba a ye ka be ye.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: T’a kẽng ka, n leb ka, a pa yãnd ned ye .
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La, a rɩka sorã, n na n bao rao wã ne a biigã.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: La, wakat-kãng tɩ b taa yiri.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Yaa woto, la biigã maan n fãag a ba wã, la a menga.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: Bɩ d ra kɩɩs d kambã noor wakat ning ye, d mi n kelgd-ba.
title: 1 Nin-kẽem a yembr

text: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: Ned a ye, n wa n na n tog sore.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: La, a sẽn wa n kolg tẽngã sẽn pa yɩɩd wakat a yiib kẽnde, la a tudg sorã.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: T’a gõodẽ n baood tẽngã sorã n kongdẽ, hal tɩ ko-yũud la kom wa tar-a.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: La, a wa n kẽn n tɩ mika rao sẽn zĩ sor noore.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: Mik, rao wã sẽn zĩ wã, yaa gãeenga, la so-toagdã ra ka mi ye.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: T’a pʋʋse, tɩ gãeengã leok-a.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: Tɩ rao wã sok-a :
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: «Mam tudga Dõosẽ tẽngã sor n dat tɩ y wilg-ma ».
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: La gãeenga yeel-a lame :
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: «Fo pa ne toɛɛgã sẽn be taoorã sɩda ?
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: » Tɩ rao wã leoke :
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: «N-yẽ!
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: ” Tɩ gãeengã yeel-a :
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: «Fo sã n tɩ loog toɛɛgã, n ta taoor bilfu, bɩ f wẽneg n kẽ f yẽdgẽ wã, tɩ Dõosẽ sor la be ».
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: Fo zab ne gãeenga, pa tar yõodo, fo sĩnd f noor me, sũ-toogo.
title: 2 So-taogd a ye kibare

text: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Arzɛk soab n da be tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ, n tar pagb la kamb wʋsgo.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: A rũm-bãoonegã pa tõe n sõd n sa ye :
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Niisi, piisi, bʋʋse, noos la kĩini.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La ne rẽ fãa, a ra koosda gʋʋr la taba.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La, ra yaa ned me, sẽn dɩk ligdi, tɩ lebg a Wẽnnaam.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Ned sã n da a bũmbu, t’a ligd pa a nengẽ, a soab pa tõe n le paam ligd-kãng ye.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Fo sã n pa tar ligd me, f ka tõe n paam bũmb a nengẽ ye.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Ned bʋʋg bɩ a pesg sã n lʋɩ a rũmsã sʋka, a ka le yit ye; yẽ n na n soog-a.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La, sãan sã n wa sig-a, yaa rũng ning a sẽn ka so wã, la a na n yõk n kʋ n moneg sãanã, sẽn na yɩl, tɩ sãanã sũur yɩ noogo, t’a ning-a barka.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Bala, nebã yetame, tɩ f sã n maan sãan yel-sõmde, a wat n leba f menga, wall f kamba.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La nin-kãngã ra yĩmame, tɩ yẽ sẽn wẽgd nebã, tõe n leba a menga, tɩ b ka gomd a kambã ye.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La, sẽn ya yell n tɩ yɩɩda, yaa tɩ f tɩɩm ka tõe-a ye.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Fo ka tõe me, n bool-a bʋʋd ye, tɩ bala, a tara tõogo, hal tɩ tẽngã nebã fãa wa gomd a yelle.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La sẽn wa n beẽ n beẽ, Wẽnnaam nin-sõng a ye, n da bʋʋg ne pesg n na n gʋʋle.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Tɩ bʋʋgã tõsga a wĩirã, n kẽng n tɩ lagem a rũmsã.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Tɩ nin-sõngã yet t’a na n gome, tɩ tẽngã nebã yeel-a, t’a pĩnd n sĩnd a noorã, tɩ arzɛkã soaba ka nin-sõng ye.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La ne rẽ fãa, rao wã kell n talla raoodo, n kẽng n tɩ yãnd arzɛkã soaba n yeel-a :
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: «Mam daa bʋʋg n loe n na n gʋʋle, t’a tõsg a wĩirã n wa naag yãmb rũmsã.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Ad-a sẽn gãe, m bõos n yõk-a ».
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Tɩ arzɛkã soab leok-a :
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: «Yaa ziri, bʋ-kãngã roga ka n bɩ ka , yaa mam bʋʋga; da bao m noor yibeoogã ye».
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: La, bʋʋgã soab sẽn mi a yellã yĩnga, a ka bao n na n bʋ ne-a ye.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: A yeela arzɛkã soab bala :
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: «Wẽnnaam yaa m kaset soaba.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Foom, la m kaset a yiib-n-soaba.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Sã n mikame, tɩ bʋʋgã yaa mam dẽnda, ka ne vẽere, d na gese.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Fo rũmsã fãa na sa, n bas-fo ».
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Sɩd me, sẽoogã sẽn wa n ta, saag n tãs a rũmsã n kʋ n kell rũms piiga.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Dẽ poore, we-baas n wa n yõg a rũmsã fãa, n wãb n kell rao wã bʋʋg bala.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: Rẽ wã, Wẽnnaam deegda ka-pãng soab zĩig n zabe.
title: 3 Arzẽk soab a ye kibare

text: 4 Zood yõbg yelle.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: Wakat fãa, kinkirg a yembr n yit weoogã pʋgẽ, n lebgd ned n wat n dood tẽn-bil a ye raaga.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, a wa n yõga zood ne rao a ye.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, a sã n wa raag fãa, b bee ne taaba.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, rao wã n yikame, n zomb a wed-moaag n na n tɩ kaag-a.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, a sẽn wa n ta zakẽ wã n pʋʋse, a zoa wã sẽn ya kinkirgã, sɩd yiime n pʋʋs-a, n lebg n kẽ a roogẽ.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, vugr bala, zakã lebga kãgre.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: Tɩ rao wã ket n zĩẽ, sẽn yi bilfu, la kinkirgã ba wã la a ma wã, tɩ yi n pʋʋs-a n lebg n kẽ.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, rao wã wed-moaagã wa n kʋmame, t’a tik n yiki, n tɩ kolg-a.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La wed-moaagã yeel-a lame :
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: «Mam yãbr a tãab-n-soabã sã n mik tõnd ka, b na n kʋʋ tõndo».
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La rao wã lebgame, n tɩ zĩndi.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La wed-moaagã le kʋmame, tɩ rao wã yik n wudg n tɩ ta, n yɩk n zomb wed-moaagã, n na n zoe n kuili.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, a zoa wã me lebga neda, n zomb a wed-moaaga, n na n dig-a.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: B sẽn tar taab rigbu, rao wã wed-moaagã wa n yaame, tɩ bɛ wã ket n pʋgd-a.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: Tɩ rao wã yeel a wed-moaagã :
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: «Sã n yaa m ba ne m ma n da foo n kõ maam, bɩ f ra sak tɩ yãnd paam maam ye».
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: Wakat-kãnga, rao wã kẽem bãnga a yamẽ, t’a yao wã bee yell pʋga.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: A tik n yikame, n dɩk a bug-raoogo, n bob n yɩk n zomb a wed-moaagã, n dɩk sorã, n na n babs-ba.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, a wa n tool n ne-b, b sẽn wate, tɩ wubsgã tʋke.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: T’a yalse, n maneg a bug-raoogã, n tees n gũudẽ.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: La, a yao wã wa n pɩʋʋgame, t’a kẽemã kell n tees bug-raoogã, ned ning sẽn pʋgdã zugu, n wẽ, tɩ kinkirgã yak n lʋɩ n ki.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: Rẽ wã, zood yõgda ne gũusgu.
title: 4 Zood yõbg yelle

text: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Nem-koaas a ye n wa n da naafo.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La, a yãka yam, n yeel t’a ka na n kʋ naafã zõaag sẽn be zĩig ning ye.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La a yikame, n na n kẽn n kẽ we-raoog pʋgẽ ne naafã, n na n bao zĩig ning zõaag sẽn ka be, n kʋ-a.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La, a bi-bilf yikame, t’a na n tũ-a lame, la, a ba wã tõdgame.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La biigã baoo tompeglem n ning a ba wã korgã pʋgẽ, n yaool n poog võ-bil korgã tẽngre, t’a ba wã sã n na n looge, bɩ a tõog n tũ tompeglmã vũkã, n pʋg-a.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Rao wã sɩd wa n yikame, n dɩk a korgã n bobe, n pid a naafã wĩiri, n tat n kẽed weoogã.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La, a biigã yikame, n get tompeglmã, n pʋgd a ba wã.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: A ba wã wa n wẽnegame, n yã biigã t’a pʋgd-a.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: A ka le tõe n yeel biigã t'a lebg n kuil ye.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Bala, b zoe n bee weoogã sʋka.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La, b naaga taab n tar kẽna marsã.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La rao wã yeela a biigã t’a sã bĩndu.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La biigã sãame tɩ zõosã wa.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ rao wã yet tɩ naafã kʋʋb zĩig pa ka ye.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b le tar kẽn n tar kẽna.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: A le wa n yeela a biigã t’a sã, tɩ biigã sɩd sã, la zõosã yɩɩ wãa… n wa.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La rao wã yeelame, tɩ naafã kʋʋb zĩig nan ka ta ye.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b sɩd be taoor sãagre.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: A le wa n yeela a biigã t’a sã, tɩ biigã sã, tɩ zõos ka wa ye, t’a yeele, tɩ marsã, naafã kʋʋb zĩig taame.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: B loee naafã n lub n kodg-a ne sʋʋga.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Rao wã yaool n tʋma biigã, t’a kẽng n tɩ mok bugum, n wa tɩ b sẽ naafã sãoore.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Biigã kẽngame n na n mok bugmã, n tɩ mik tɩ bugmã soab yaa kinkirga, la a sokame :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «Ãnda n wa n kogsd m yẽdga ?».
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ biigã leoke :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «Yaa m ba n tʋm maam, tɩ m wa mok bugum n wa t’a sẽ sãoore ” Tɩ kinkirgã sok-a :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «M sã n wa, m na n paamame bɩ ?».
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La biigã leok-a lame :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «N-yẽe !»
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Kinkirgã sẽn kẽng n tɩ ta b zĩigẽ wã, a yeel-b lame :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «Rɩk-y pʋ-teedã n wa ne».
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b rɩk n kõ-a t’a reeg n vole.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: N le yeel-ba :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «Wa-y ne gɛyã ne bãgdã».
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b kõ-a t’a reeg n vole.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: N le yeel-b yasa :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «M data zugã ne gãongã n paase».
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b rɩk n kõ-a, la b na n zoe.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: B zoe n tɩ kẽe roog a ye pʋg n na n solge.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Mik, roogã yaa kinkirgã roogo.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: A sẽn wa n ta, a maaga a meng n wʋb nemdã fãa laag pʋgẽ, n yaool n dɩk a sag-rʋk n na n moe sagbo.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: A sẽn wa n moe n sa, a rɩka laagã ne rɩɩbã, n bĩng a poorẽ wã.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La biigã ne a ba wã sẽn da solg pĩirã poorẽ wã, rɩka rɩɩbã n dɩ tɩ yɩ-b noogo, hal tɩ zẽedã wa sa.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Nemdã yĩnga, zẽedã sɩd yɩɩ noog tɩ looge.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Biigã yikame n na n bõos zẽedã.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: T’a ba wã yɩ tao-tao n yeel-a, t’a ra mak, tɩ kinkirgã na n kʋ-b lame.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ biigã zĩẽ n zĩẽ, n wa kelme, n yeele :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «Pʋg-yãanga, m kota zẽedo!»
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La kinkirgã yikame, n wudg n tɩ tigim we-rũmsã fãa n yeel tɩ :
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: «pʋg-yãang-m-kota-zẽed n be m doogẽ wã, n dat n kʋ maam».
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: We-rũmsã fãa wa n naaga taab n wa gũbg roogã, n na n gese.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: B yaool n tʋma m ba Yõngr t’a tɩ ges bõe n be roogã pʋgẽ.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: La m ba Yõngr sẽn wa n tar lamsg n dabd n na n gese, la biigã sẽn yã-a, n wẽ-a n kʋ.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b yeel m ba Yũug t’a kolg n gese.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: T’a kolg n yaees n lebge.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ b le yeele, tɩ m ba Rãaneg kolg marsã, n ges tɩ yẽ yubl n woagem la!
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: T’a sɩd yɩ gond-gond n kolge, tɩ biigã fiuuga a yublã ne sʋʋga.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ m ba Rãaneg tar po-tulli, n tɩ rok n lʋɩ zʋko!
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Lebga yelle.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ m ba Yʋgempend yet tɩ bõe la wã?
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Tɩ m ba Wobg rãmb zoe bilf-bilfu, tɩ bãmb ra wa lʋɩ b nao-bogd pʋsẽ, n pa tõog n yi ye.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: Rẽ wã, ned fãa sã n na n saag n mak, n maan bũmbu, bɩ a mag wʋsg la a kos saglgo, sã n pa rẽ, a sẽn na n maanã, wat n tõe n wa nafa ned a to n bas-a.
title: 5 Nem-koaas a ye kibare

text: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba Katre kibare.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Soaamb da mi n kẽnd n tãooda ware, ne m ba Wobgo.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La wakat fãa, a Soaamb basdame, tɩ m ba Wobg kʋʋd-a.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Bala, a Wobg sã n kʋ-a, a laadame, n bas a yẽdgã tɩ yaage, tɩ m ba Soaamb kẽedẽ, n tõsda a nemdã n kuiis ne, tɩ kõt a pagã, t’a rʋgd tɩ b wãbdẽ.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Daar a ye, m ba Katr pagã, wa n na n moka bugum, a Soaamb zakẽ wã, tɩ b yãk nemdã n kõ-a.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Katr pagã kẽname, n ta sorã zugu, n wãb nemdã fãa la a rʋʋd rʋʋd-koom, n kiis bugmã, n lebg n wa n na n mok bugmã yasa.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, b sã n kõ-a, a sã n le ta sorẽ wã, a wãbda nemdã yasa, la, a rʋʋd n kiis bugmã n lebg n wa.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: A sẽn wa wãb n tɩg marsã, la, a yaool n na n zã nemdã, n kuil n tɩ kõ a sɩda.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Katr me, sẽn lemb n mik tɩ ya noogã, a maka gõeem n kong n yik n sok a pagã:
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Ãnd n kõ foo nemdã?»
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La pagã yeelame, tɩ yaa m ba Soaamba.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Katr sãda yibeoog pĩnda, n tɩ sok m ba Soaamba :
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Fo maanda wãn-wãn to-to, n paamd nemdã wʋsg woto, n wãbd tɩ sekd-fo, la f tõe n yãk n kõ f taaba?»
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb yeel-a :
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Kuil la f wa beoogo, tɩ d kẽng n tɩ bao».
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Katr sãda yibeoog pĩnda, n wa nek m ba a Soaamba, tɩ b na n kẽng n tɩ tão ware, ne m ba Wobgo.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb sẽn le wa n ta, a sɩd basda a meng wakat fãa, tɩ m ba Wogb tãood warã, n kʋʋd-a.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, b sẽn tar tãoob n tar tãoobo, m ba Soaamb le wa n bas a menga, tɩ m ba Wobg kʋ-a, n bas n la, n yaag a yẽdgã woo…!
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a Soaamb ne a Katr yɩk n kẽ.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb yeela m ba Katre :
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Da tõsg sũurã kaamã ye.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Da mak n sɩɩs yamã me ye ».
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B sẽn wa n tar nemdã wõrsgo, m ba a Katr zoe-bõn soabã, kẽngame n tɩ wõrg sũurã, tɩ m ba Wobg ki, t’a yẽdgã page.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B sẽn ka le tõe n yi wã yĩnga, m ba Soaamb kẽe pʋ-bilã pʋgẽ n solge.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Katr me, kẽe pʋ-bedrã pʋgẽ n solge.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La we-gõodb n wa n yã a Wobg sẽn n ki n dɩga, tɩ b vu-a n kẽes tɩɩg maasem tẽngre, n na n pase.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B sẽn wa n pas-a n sa, b kõo biig pʋ-bilã, t’a tɩ lob bok pʋga.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Biigã sɩd rɩka pʋʋrã, n na n tɩ lobe.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: A sẽn wa n kolg bokã, la, m ba Soaamb sẽn da be pʋ-bilã pʋgẽ wã, yeel-a :
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Da lob yambẽ n ka ye, sãag n kẽng taoore».
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ biigã loog n dabd taoore, n na n tɩ lob-a begdẽ.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Sãag taoor yasa».
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ biigã sɩd be ne-a taoor sãagre, n tɩ ta zĩ-peel pʋgẽ, n fãeeg-a be.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb yɩɩ tao-tao n pãrg pʋ-bilã n yi purss…n lebg n wa ta, n yeele :
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Yãmb ka ne pʋ-bedrã ?
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Ned kam fãa rɩk raoogo, n wa wẽ-a, tɩ d ges bõe n be be ».
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La ned kam fãa sɩd baoo raoog n wa.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb kõo noore, tɩ b naag taab n wẽ pʋʋrã.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Katr zĩnda pʋgẽ wã, n kelem wii…!
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B yaool n pãrga pʋʋrã, n dɩk a Katr n maneg n paas a wobg nemdã, n pas n pʋɩ taaba, n kuil n tɩ rʋge.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Rẽ yĩnga, ka f nin sẽn ne fãa, la f rɩt ye.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: D mi n deeg saglse.
title: 6 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Bi-bɩɩg a ye n paam zu-noogo, tɩ Wẽnnaam ning-a barka, t’a sɩng tolbo, n daad ki, bɛnga, la kood buud toor-toore, n paas ne rũm-bãoonego, n leebdẽ, tɩ sɩd tar barka.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La, yʋʋm piig loogr poore, a arzɛkã sɩd fɩɩga sõma.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La rao wã, sẽn da tar sulg-m-meng yĩnga, kɩtame, tɩ nebã ra waoogd-a.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Ra yaa ned me, sẽn da get a roagdbã yell sõma.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La, nebã wa n sɩngame, n yet rao wã:
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: «Haya!
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: fo sã n ka gilim n bao kogl-m-menga, f bɛɛbã na n kʋ-f lame, wala b sãam f paoongã ».
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La rẽ tɛka, rao wã pa le tõe n gũs ye.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Tɩ bala, a ra tara tagsg wʋsg a mengã ne a paoongã yĩnga.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: T’a na n dɩk yellã, n togs a zoa a yembre.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La, a zoa wã, yãag-a-la tɩɩm soab nengẽ, n tɩ ta n togs a zu-loɛɛgã.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La tɩɩmã soab yeel-b lame :
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: «Yãmb sẽn ta ka wã, bɩ y ra le maan yɩɩr ye.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Yãnd ka na n yã yãmb ye, y yellã manegame.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Tɩɩm ning mam sẽn na n kõ foomã, fo sã n wa n lebg n ta yiri, bɩ f ning-a bẽerẽ, n dɩ la f tall raoodo.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Ned sã n bao n na n maan foom wẽng marsã, wẽngã na n leba a soaba.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La, tɩɩmã kisa fo sẽn na n kãab ned wẽnga, bala, kãabgã na n paama pidsgu, a soabã vɩɩm pʋgẽ, fo me na n paama yelle».
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: B sẽn sɩd reeg tɩɩmã n kuili, b sɩd tɩ maana wa a sẽn togsã.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La, biigã sẽn bãng tɩ ned a to ka le tõe n maan-a wẽngã, wuk-m-meng kẽ-a lame, t’a toor ka le be ne ned a to yas ye.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: La, moos maana b yel-bũndi :
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: «Lar sã n noome, a to n kɛ a saala».
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: A tʋʋm-yoodã, la nebã kãabgã, la b paoogrã, Wẽnnaam bas-a lame, t’a paoongã sat n dabda, t’a zakã pʋga, wʋm-taab ka le be yẽ ne a pagbã sʋk ye.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Bi-bɩɩgã yõor yɩɩ koɛɛga, bala, a ka le tõe n vɩɩmde, wa a sẽn da tar ligda wakat ye.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Ra lebga sũ-toogo, rɩɩbã ka le yaa sõma wa pĩnda ye.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Yẽ ne a zĩnd-n-taasã, la tẽngã nebã, ra yaa beem.
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: Rẽ wã, wuk-m-meng rolb yaa lʋɩɩse
title: 7 Bi-bɩɩg a yembr kibare

text: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba Katre kibare.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Daar a ye, noosã maana tigr n na n sao.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, sẽn na n yɩlẽ, tɩ reemã yɩ noogo, m ba Soaamb kẽnga ne kʋnde, koom ne guugu, n tɩ ta n pʋʋs-ba.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La noosã soka m ba Soaamba :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Yaa noog ne kʋnde, koom la guugu ?
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb leok-b lame :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Kʋndã, yaa sẽn na n tar n wẽedẽ, tɩ y saoodẽ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Guugã, yaa sẽn na n tar n gũud yãmba.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Koomã, yaa sẽn na n tar n walgd zĩigã, tɩ wubsgã ra yikdẽ ye.»
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb wa n sɩnga kʋndã wẽebo, hal tɩ noosã tar saooga.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Soaamb wa n basa kʋndã wẽebo, la a yɩ tao-tao, n dʋ tɩɩgã ne koomã, n walge.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Noosã zoe n kẽe roogẽ, n tẽed tɩ yaa saaga n niidẽ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: T’a sig n dɩk a guugã, n kẽ n pãb noosã, n kʋ, n wʋk n sui a waoogẽ, n kuil n tɩ kõ a paga, t’a maneg n dʋg tɩ b wãbe.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Katr pagã, wa n na n moka bugum, m ba Soaamb zakẽ wã.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, b yãka nemdã n kõ-a, t’a kuil n tɩ wãb ne a sɩda.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, m ba a Katr yeela a pagã :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Ad nemdã yaa noog dɛ».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, a pagã sũur puugame t’a yeel-a :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Fo ka bark ye.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Fo taaba fãa wat n kõta b pagbã rɩɩbo, tɩ b rɩtẽ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La fo zɩ, n wa ne rɩɩb ka ye».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Katr sãdame n tɩ nek m ba Soaamb n soke :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Fo maanda wãn to-to, n paamd nemdã woto fãa, n wat n dɩt ne f zak-rãmba?
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: » La, m ba Soaamb yeel-a lame :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Beoogo, bɩ y wa ne kʋnde, koom la gũug tɩ d kẽnge».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Katr tɩ maka gõeem, n kong n yik n yõgneg bugum n wa yeel m ba Soaamba, tɩ beoogã vẽegame, la, a yik tɩ b looge.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb yeel-a :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Kẽng-y, tɩ pʋg-yãang sã n tĩs bɩ y wa tɩ d looge».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Katr tɩ baoo tɩpare, n to, n kẽng n tɩ ning pʋg-yãang kokorẽ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, pʋg-yãang tĩsame t’a lebg n wa yã m ba Soaamba, n yet t’a yik tɩ b looge.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: T’a Soaamb yeel-a :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Kẽng-y tɩ no-raoog sã n kũmi, bɩ y lebg n wa».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Katr kẽngame, n tɩ wẽoog no-raoog kokor tɩ noaagã kelme, t’a lebg n wa.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Soaamb yaool n mak n kongame, n yiki, tɩ b tũ taab n looge.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, a Soaamb yeela m ba Katre :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Y sã n ta, bɩ y pʋʋs-b fãa.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: B sã n sok teed nins yãmb sẽn zãadã yelle, bɩ y yeel-ba :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Kʋndã, yaa sẽn na n tar n wẽedẽ, tɩ y saoodẽ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Koomã, yaa sẽn na n tar n walgd zĩigã, tɩ wubsgã ra yikdẽ ye.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Guugã, yaa sẽn na n tall n kẽ n pãb yãmb n kʋ».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: B sẽn wa n ta, m ba Katr pʋʋsa noosã, tɩ b sok-a :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «M ba Katre !
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: kʋndã, koomã, la guugã, yaa sẽn na n tar n maand bõe ?».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Katr yeele:
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Koomã, yaa sẽn na n tar n walgd zĩigã, tɩ wubsgã ra yikdẽ ye.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Kʋndã, yaa sẽn na n tar n wẽedẽ, tɩ y saoodẽ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Guugã, yaa sẽn na n tall n kẽ n pãb yãmb n kʋ».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Katr wa n sɩd sɩnga kʋndã wẽebo, tɩ noosã me sɩng saooga, wa yell ka be ye.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, m ba Katr wa n yikame, n dɩk koomã, n walge.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Tɩ noosã zoe n kẽ roogã pʋga, n yɩ tao-tao, n pak fenetrã, n bas vɩʋʋgo.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: A Katr me, yɩɩ tao-tao, n wa ta, n na n pãb-b ne guugã.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Tɩ noosã tũ fenetrã, n yi, tɩ b kõbdã sʋʋg n pa.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: M ba Katr sẽn yã rẽ wã, a tẽedame, tɩ yaa noosã, t’a kẽng n ta, n kool n sui a waoogẽ, n tall n kuili.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: A sẽn ta a yiri, a yeela a pagã :
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: «Vaag baag bɛndã, n lob tãmpʋʋrẽ, tɩ rɩ-bɛd waame».
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, a pagã sɩd vaaga baag bɛndã, n lobe.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: La, m ba Katr sẽn zuk waoogã, n pẽes no-kõbdã, n tẽed t’a na n yãa noaag a pʋgẽ, a pa yã baa fɩ.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: T’a sũurã sãame, t’a yãs sɩɩ...
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: Rẽ wã, pẽdgr yiisda yam, n tõe kɩte, t’a soab kẽ moogo, t’a baasg lebg sũ-sãanga.
title: 8 M ba Soaamb la m ba

text: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba Katre, ne m ba Weoognaaba kibare.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: M ba Soaamba, m ba Katre, ne m ba Weoognaaba, naaga taaba, n ko ki, n ning baoor tɩ pidi.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La ned kam fãa, sẽn wa n na n leb a yiri, b kõo taab sɛka, n na n lebg n wa pʋɩ ki wã.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb lebgame, n wa kẽ baoorã pʋgẽ, n dɩ ki wã, n kell kɩdga.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, sɛkã daar sẽn wa n ta, b fãa sɩd waame, n na n pʋɩ ki wã.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, b sẽn lɩk baoorã pʋga, b mikame, tɩ ki wã kella kɩdga.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Tɩ b sok ned fãa, n na n bãnge, ãnda n dɩ ki wã.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, b soka m ba Katre :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Yaa foom, n dɩ ki wã bɩ?»
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, m ba Katr leokame :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Ayoo !
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Mam sẽn yi ka, badaarã, mam kẽnga keedẽ, n yi keedẽ, n kẽng yõobẽ, n yi yõobẽ, n kẽng bʋdbẽ, n yi bʋdbẽ, n kẽng koobẽ, n yi koobẽ, n kẽng bɛng rɩgsgo, n yi bɛng rɩgsgo, n kẽng kẽebgẽ, n yi kẽebgẽ, n kẽng tigsgẽ, n yi tigsgẽ, n kẽng rɩɩbẽ.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Mam sẽn nan wat la woto ».
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, b soka m ba Soaamba, ne m ba Weoognaaba, tɩ bãmb me leoke, wa, m ba Katr sẽn leokã.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, b sẽn na n maan bũmb ning marsã, n bãng ned ning sẽn dɩ-a ki wã, b rɩka ka-kellã, n pãb n yelge, n maan zom-pãrga, n ning wamd pʋgẽ, n dɩk n doglg nobg wɛɛsẽ n yaool yeel ned fãa, t’a yɩk n zʋʋg zomã ne wamdã.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, a Katr ne, a Weoognaab tõog n yɩkame, n zʋʋg wamdã ne zomã, tɩ bũmb ka maan ye.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb sã n mak t’a na n yɩk fãa, a ka tõe ye, t’a yetẽ :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Yaa fũugã n liib maam».
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: T’a yãk fũugã, n dɩglge, n le mak t’a na n yɩke, n ka tõog ye, n le yeele :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Yaa mam puglã n liib maam».
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: B fãa wa n bãnga vẽeneg pay, marsã, tɩ yaa m ba Soaamba, n dɩ ki wã.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Tɩ b na n dig-a.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: B sẽn tar a rigbã, b wa tɩ n yãa nob-miidu, la, m ba Soaamb yɩɩ tao-tao, n yeel-ba :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Yãmb basa rɩɩbo, n digd maam zaalem ».
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Tɩ b fãa naag taaba, n sok-a :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Rɩɩbã bɛ ?»
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb yeele :
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Ad nob-miidu ».
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, b fãa kẽe nob-miidã wãbre, n bas tɩ m ba Soaamb zoe n solge.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Rẽ wã, sɩlem-wẽng soab sã n be sull pʋgẽ, sullã neb raabo, ka baasd neer ye.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Rẽnd tɩ b mao t’a soab toeem zʋgo.
title: 9 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba Katre kibare.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Soaamba, ne m ba Katr wa n yii gõobo.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb ra reng n baoo ka-zẽeg zug n ning a waoog pʋga.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B sẽn wa n tar kẽna, b tɩ yãa bõnyẽeg kamb a yiibu, n dɩk-ba n sui b waoos pʋsẽ.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb yeela a Katre :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «D kao bõnyẽegã kamb zutu».
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, Katr sɩd yɩɩ tao-tao, n kaoog a rẽ wã zugu.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb tʋmame, n kaoog ka-zẽegã zugu tɩ sak põra, tɩ m ba Katr tẽ, tɩ yaa sɩda.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B wa n kẽname, n tɩ seg m ba Bõnyẽega, t’a sok-ba :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Yãmb ka yã mam kambã?»
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb leok-a :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «D yã-b lame ».
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a bõnyẽeg yeel-ba :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Wa-y ne-ba!
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb yɩ tao-tao, n wõog a rẽndã n kõ.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «La foom»?
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a Katr wõog a rẽ wã n mik t’a kiime.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, a yɩɩ tao-tao n yeele :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «A laada, a laada ».
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a bõnyẽeg be m ba a Katr rigbu.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb lamsd n pʋgda.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, a Katr wa n zoe, n tɩ kẽe yaoor bokẽ.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a bõnyẽeg ne a Soaamb na n tu bokã.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B sẽn wa n tar bokã tuubu, n wa kolg m ba Katre, b baoo yamsem ne tɩpare, n to, n puus a Katr bokã pʋga.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Katr me, zĩnda boka pʋga, n kok n lebs n puus-ba.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a bõnyẽeg kok n lembe, n bas n yeel m ba Soaamba :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Ad Katrã fulfuldã noomame dɛ»!
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb leok-a :
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Bas rẽ, a sãoorã noom n yɩɩda».
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Rẽ wã, bɩ gũus-y, tɩ nina manesem, yaa tudgr manesem, sẽn na bao yell n dogl yãmba.
title: 10 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: 11 Kũum ne dasãare !
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Rao n wa n kẽng bagre.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La, bagrã soab yeel-a lame, t’a bao yɩbrg-vɩɩga, n bila a yĩngã, la a rɩke, n maan maoongo, rasem a yopoe pʋgẽ, sã n ka rẽ, a na n kiime.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Rao wã pelẽnga, yɩkame, t’a yik n dɩk weoogã sore, n tar yãbr n teesdẽ.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La, a wa n tɩ sega pʋg-yãanga a yembre.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Mam kẽngame, n na n tɩ bao m yɛl võore, bagr soab nengẽ, t’a yeele, tɩ m bao yɩbrg-vɩɩg n bil m yĩngã, n maan maoongo.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La, m na n paam-a la yɛ?».
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La pʋg-yãangã yeelame :
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Tɩ sã n ya woto tɛka, ka toog ye.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Bao dasãare, n kẽng zĩ-peelẽ wã, n tɩ gãand zãmbeelle, f poorã zugu, n nodg f ninã, wa f kiime.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Yɩbrdã sã n yã foo, b na n tẽeme, tɩ yaa kũum, tɩ b na n dɩ.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Tɩ f paam-ba, n yõke.»
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Rao wã kẽngame, n sɩd maane, wa pʋg-yãangã sẽn yeelã.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Sẽn yɩ bilf bala, la yɩbrg naab sẽn laale, n wa ta n sãage, n kẽng n tɩ ta, n zomb tɩɩga, n yetẽ :
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Õ’õ, mam nan pa rɩ kũum, ne dasãar ye».
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Rẽ poore, yʋʋm a tãab yɩbrgo, n wa n ta, n laandẽ, n dat n sigi, n dɩ-a.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La, yɩbrg naab bool-a lame, n soke :
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Fo sẽn dog tɛka, fo yãa kũum ne dasãare ?»
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: T’a yet tɩ ayoo !
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Bɩ, f loog n bao zĩiga, n zaoonde».
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Sẽn kaoos bilfu, la yʋʋm a yiib yɩbrg sẽn wa n ta n laandẽ, n dat n dɩ rao wã, tɩ yɩbrg naab bool-a n soke :
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Fo sẽn dog tɛka, fo rɩɩ kũum ne dasãare?
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: » T’a yet tɩ ayoo!
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Bɩ, f bao zĩig n zaoonde».
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Yʋʋmd a yembr yɩbrg me, n ta, n laandẽ.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Tɩ b naabã sok-a :
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: «Fo sẽn dog tɛka, fo rɩɩ kũum ne dasãare ?»
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La, a leokame, tɩ yẽ sẽn dɩ a buudu, yaa wʋsgo.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: La, yɩbr naab yeel-a lame, t’a gũus a menga, la a ka kelg ye.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: A yɩkame, n tɩ zomb rao wã zugu, n na n dɩ-a, tɩ rao wã be a nao wã gãdbẽ, n tar a mengã yĩng bilbu.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: Rẽ wã, nin-kẽem sã n sagl biiga, bɩ a reege, la a ra paoog-a, t’a yãa pĩnda.
title: 11 Kũum ne dasãare

text: 12 Pag a yembr kibare.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Pag a ye, n wa n be tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: La, a ra yaa sũ-kĩ-neda, la zoe-bõn soaba, n le yaa wagdre.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: A pʋg-taabã la yagsã teed sã n menme, sã n tar-n-tarẽ, yaa pagã nengẽ, la b yãt teedã.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Hal, tɩ sakã neb fãa, wa gomd a yelle.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Kãang a yembr me, n be tẽngã sʋka, t’a raadã pa wɩɩsd ye.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: La, pagã wa n yika daar a yembre, n tɩ wɩɩs kãangã raado.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Kãangã zĩnã yɩkame, n zõd pagã, n yet t’a rũng-a poor n kuili.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Tɩ pagã sɩd make, n kong n buk-a, n ta yiri, n yalse, n yeel-a :
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: «Sig tɩ m lub m raado, t’a tõdge, sig tɩ m moe sagbo, t’a tõdge, tɩ pagã rũng-a n tar-a n gilimd ne zakã, la a tar yãbre, tɩ sakã nebã fãa, wa gũbg-a, n getẽ.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: La, zĩnã basame, t’a nams sõma, t’a yaool n wa yeel-a :
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: «Rɩk raadã n tɩ lebs kãangã pʋgẽ tao-tao, sã n ka rẽ, mam ka na n bas-f ye».
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: La, pagã sɩd talla raadã n tɩ lebs kãangã pʋgẽ, n na n paam a menga.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Rẽ wã yĩnga, sẽn kisa, sɩd kisame.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: Sẽn ka maande, sɩd ka maand ye.
title: 12 Pag a yembr kibare

text: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba Katre kibare.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: M ba Soaamba, ne m ba Katr wa n zemsa taaba, n tuk bɛng pʋʋg ned kam fãa, n na n ko.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, sẽoog sẽn wa n ta, b fãa tɩ bʋdame, ne b zak rãmba.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Bɛngã womb wakat sẽn wa n ta, m ba Katr rẽ wã, maana puud sõma, n dat n wome, n yɩɩd m ba Soaamb rẽndã.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La m ba Soaamb sẽn yã rẽ, a talla sũ-kĩiri, ne m ba Katre, a bɛngã yĩnga.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: A kẽngame, n tɩ yã m ba Katre, n yeel-a :
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Wa tɩ d kẽnge, n tɩ pãb d bɛnsã puudã n sʋʋge, rẽ, b womda saal-saala, bɛd-bɛda, wogd-wogdo.»
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, a Katr sakame, tɩ b kẽnge, n tɩ pãb a rẽ wã puudã, n sʋʋge.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La daar ning b sẽn segd n tɩ pãbe, m ba a Soaamb bɛngã puudã n sʋʋge, m ba Soaamb yika yibeoog pĩndã, n kẽng n tɩ solg sorã noore, piding poore.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: M ba Katr sẽn wa n loogdẽ, m ba Soaamb yɩɩ purss… n yi, tɩ, m ba Katr yaeese, n lebg n zoe n kuili.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb le yɩɩ tao-tao, n deng m ba Katr yiri.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: A Katr sẽn wa n ta n yã m ba Soaamb a zakẽ wã, a yeel-a lame :
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Mam da rabda weoogẽ wã, tɩ bũmb tek n dig maam, tɩ tõnd mao ne taaba, t’a sã bĩndu.»
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: La, m ba Soaamb yeelame, tɩ sã n yaa woto, a na n baoo tɩɩm, n were, n tɩ yuglg bĩndã, tɩ sẽn sã-a bĩndã, ki ».
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Tɩ, m ba Katr yeel-a :
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: «Fo sã n na n tɩ yuglgi, bɩ f yuglg bilf-bilfu, tɩ tõnd fãa bĩndã kalma taaba.»
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: Zãag f meng ne sũ-kĩir soaba, n paam tɩ f paoong yalse, n fɩɩg n tall barka.
title: 13 M ba Soaamba, ne m ba

text: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Rao a ye, n wa n be tẽng a yembr pʋgẽ.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, rao wã ra nonga pagb wʋsgo.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Ned bi-neere, bɩ a pʋg-neere, ka pɩʋʋgd a taoor ye.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Hal tɩ saka neba, tẽngã la tẽn-yagsã fãa, wa gomd a zĩnd-n-ta-kõb-wẽndlmã yelle.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, sẽn wa n beẽ n beẽ, kinkirg n lebg pʋg-neere, n wa rɩk-a n maan a sɩda, tɩ b be ne taaba.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, bʋdb wakat sẽn wa n ta, rao wã sã n kẽng ne a pagã, n tɩ bʋd ki wã, n lebg zaabr n kuili, pagã yikda tõd-beoog pĩnda, n tɩ bool a koden-n-taasã, tɩ b wa gaas sẽbdã n dɩ ki wã.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Rao wã sã n yik yibeoogo, n tɩ ta a pʋʋgẽ wã, a sũurã sãamda hal wʋsgo, t’a le sɩng bʋdbo.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: A sã n roog zaabr n kuili, vẽkembeoogo, a sã n leb n ta pʋʋgẽ wã, a mikdame, tɩ bʋd-bogdã fãa le gaasame.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Talla woto, tɩ rao wã, ka paam ki yʋʋm-kãng ye.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, yʋʋmd ning sẽn pʋgdã, b le kẽng n tɩ bʋdame, la b lebg n kuili.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Vẽkembeoogo, rao wã sẽn le kẽng pʋʋgẽ wã, a yãame tɩ kodensã le wa n gaasa bʋd-bogdã fãa tẽma, n dɩ ki wã.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, tãoos a yembre, n wa n na n pʋge, n gũus n gese.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Tõd-beoog sẽn wa n ta, kodensã le tũu taab wʋsgo, n wa gaasd ki wã.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, tãoosã maaga a menga, n lall n kelgd-b goamã.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, pʋʋgã soab pag yeela a taabã :
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: «Rũnda, d rɩ, la d kell m sɩd m ba Tẽedba.»
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Tãoosã sẽn wʋm dẽ, a loogame, n tɩ togs pagã sɩd kibarã.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Daar a yembre, rao wã ne a pagã wa n bee pʋʋgẽ wã n bʋtẽ, la b tar sõasga.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Rao wã yeelame :
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: «Wa tɩ d rɩ, la d kell m ba sɩd a Tẽedba.»
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: T’a pagã yeel-a, t’a ra le saag n gom woto ye, tɩ yaa yẽ kisgu.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: B sẽn ta yiri, wa tar sõasg yasa, rao wã le yeelame :
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: «Wa tɩ d rɩ, la d kell m sɩda m ba Tẽedba.»
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Pagã bãngame, tɩ rao wã wʋma bãmb sõasgã.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: La, a wa n menmame, tɩ rao wã ka bãnge, a sẽn teesẽ n ye.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Rẽ tɛka, m ba Tẽedb basa pagb roobo.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: Rẽ wã yĩnga, zʋgd buud fãa, tara a rolbo.
title: 14 Yoaad a yembr kibare

text: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Tãoos n wa n tɩ ti tãoos roogo, koom noore, n gũusd we-rũmsã, sẽn wat n yũud koomã, n tãoodẽ.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, daar a ye, a wa n kẽnga zĩigẽ wã, n na n tɩ tãoose.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, a wa n zẽka a nenga, n yã kinkirga, sẽn zĩ n sõt a ligdi.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: T’a sok a menga :
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: «M tãood-a lame n kʋ, la m sig n tɩ rɩk a ligdã bɩ?
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: » Tɩ kinkirgã gir a zugu.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: «Bɩ, m na n tɩ sõng-a lame, n sõd a ligdã, t’a yãk n kõ-ma?»
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Tɩ, kinkirgã gõms a zugu.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Rao wã kẽngme tɩ sõnga kinkirgã, n sõd a ligdã n sa.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, kinkirgã yãka ligdã, n kõ-a, t’a tõdge, n yet t’a ka rat ye, tɩ yẽ sẽn datã, ya a bãngrã.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, kinkirgã yeela rao wã :
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: «Fo ka tõe n zã bãngrã ye.»
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, rao wã yeelame, t’a tõeeme.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Kinkirgã sɩd mak n kongame, n kõ-a nug-bĩnga, la, a yeel-a, t’a ra wa saag n togs ned ye, bala, a na n kiime.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Tãoosã pag me, ra yaa nin-feoogo.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Daar a ye, a pagã wa n da werda ki neerẽ, tɩ noos wa rat n dɩ ki wã.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, no-raoog a ye, n yeela no-yãanga, t’a leb pagã goabg nif sẽn ka ne wã sẽnẽ, n liib pagã, t’a peng ki wã ne wamdã, n lub tɩ b paam n dɩ.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Tɩ, tãoosã zĩẽ n kelgdẽ.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: No-yãangã, sɩd leba pagã nug-goabgã, n liib-a t’a peng ki wã tɩ rʋʋge, tɩ b sɩd rɩ.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, pagã sɩd ra zĩime, n tar laado.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, pagã soka a sɩdã, a laadã võore, t’a sɩdã yet tɩ ka bũmb ye.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: (Bala, a sã n togse, a na n kiime).
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, pagã yeelame, t’a sã n ka wilg-a, a laadã võore, yẽ na n wʋka a teed n kuili, a ba-yir tɩ sa.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Rao wã makame, n kong n togs-a.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Dẽ poore, rao wã kiime.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, tẽngã rãmb tuu kabre, n na n mum-a.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: T’a zoa a ye, tõdge, n deeg kũumã, n dɩk-a, n kẽ weoogã, n bao zĩig n bĩng-a, n yaool n bao zĩig n solge, n get kũumã.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, dʋgr-bila, n wa n ta, n na n dɩ-a.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: A sẽn kolg n gok kũumã, la, a sẽn rok n lʋɩ, n ki.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, dʋgr naab wa n taame, n yãk tɩɩm ne zʋʋre, a korgã pʋgẽ n sɩɩs dʋgr-bilã, n yaool n yeel-a :
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: «Fo sã n mi n yã rɩɩbo, bɩ f bas tɩ dʋgr naab goke, tɩ fo yaool n goke.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Fo sã n mi n yã rɩɩbo, bɩ f bas tɩ dʋgr naab gok tɩ fo yaool n goke.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Fo sã n mi n yã rɩɩbo, bɩ f bas tɩ dʋgr naab gok tɩ fo yaool n goke.»
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Naoor a tã, tɩ dʋgrã vʋʋge.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Dʋgr naabã, kẽngame marsã, n tɩ ta, n na n dɩ kũumã.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: La, rao wã, yɩɩ tao-tao, n kẽng n tɩ rɩk zʋʋrã, n tɩ pĩng kũumã n yeele :
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: «Fo sã n mi n wʋm gomde, reng n togs f zoa, la f yaool n togs f paga.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Fo sã n mi n wʋm gomde, reng n togs f zoa, la f yaool n togs f paga.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Fo sã n mi n wʋm gomde, reng n togs f zoa, la f yaool n togs f paga.»
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Naoor a tã, tɩ kũumã tĩsi, n vʋʋge.
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: Rẽ wã, yam dɩkda, f to nengẽ
title: 15 Tãoos a yembre kibare

text: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: Rao a yembr n da tar a kamba a yiibu, la a yembrã ra yaa kɩɩba (bala, a ma wã ra kiime n bas-a), t’a yʋʋr la a Naamde.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: Kɩɩb a Naamd da tara zũur a nugẽ.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La, b yiibã sã n yi n dabd kʋɩlga, sakã nebã fãa yetame, t'a Naamd zũurã be neere.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La b sã n wa lebg n kuili, a yembrã yeta a ba wã, t’a pidg a Naamd zũurã, n kõ yẽ.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La, a pʋda yɩɩlle:
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: «Pagbã loogda, a Naamd zũurã be neere, raopã zãnga, a Naamd zũurã be neere.»
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La, a ba wã sɩd wa makame, n kong n deeg zũurã n kõ-a.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: B sẽn le yi, n dabd kʋɩlg yasa, nebã yetame, tɩ kɩɩb a Naamd be neere.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: B sẽn lebg n kuili, a yembrã le yeela a ba wã, t’a kʋ a Naamde, bala, nebã fãa yetame, t’a Naamd be neere.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: A ba wã sɩd makame n konge, n ya n kʋ a Naamd n mum-a.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La, ne rẽ fãa, nebã fãa sã n loogdẽ, b yetame, tɩ biigã yaoogã be neere.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: Biigã le yeelame, t’a ba wã kõdg yaoogã tomã, n fãeege, tɩ nebã bas b goamã.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La, a ba wã sɩd kõdga kabrã tomã n lobe.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: La, saag sẽn wa n ni, tɩ koomã zoe n kẽ bokã n pidi, sakã pagbã ne rapã sã n loogdẽ, b yetame, tɩ kabrã koom be neere.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: Biigã gom-toogã yĩng kɩtame, tɩ ba wã ne biigã, naag taab n kẽ, n na n kõdg koomã, la, b sẽn kẽ wã, b yiibã fãa paa be n ki.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: Bi-kaseng segdame, n tall bi-kaseng yam.
title: 16 Kɩɩb a Naamde kibare

text: 17 M ba Laabo kibare.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: Daar a ye, m ba Soaamba, ne m ba Katre, wa n yii gõobo.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: La, fo sã n yã gɛla, n yet tɩ ad m gelle, f kiidame.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: La, a Katr ra ka mi ye.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: La, b gõobã pʋga, b tɩ yãa gɛla, tɩ m ba Katr yɩ tao-tao, n yeel tɩ, ad m gɛla, la, a rokame, n lʋɩ n ki, tɩ m ba Soaamb tebg-a n kuili.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: Talla woto, hal tɩ wa gilg n ta m ba Laabo.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: B sẽn wa n tar gõob weoogã pʋga, m ba Soaamb wa n yeela m ba Laabo, t’a tees nug-goabga, tɩ yẽ tees nug-rɩtgo.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: La, a Laab sakame.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: Mik gɛl n da be be sẽnẽ.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: A sẽn wa n kẽn n ta gɛlã zĩigẽ wã, a sĩnda a noore, n kell n sãag n tɩ seg m ba Soaamba.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: La, m ba Soaamb gõdga ne a Laabo, n lebg n wa ta gɛlã zĩigẽ, n yeel-a :
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: «Yeel tɩ ad m gɛ...
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: T’a Laab yeele :
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: «Ad m gɛ...»
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: Soaamb wa n baas n yeela m ba Laabo, t’a yeel tɩ :
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: «Ad m gɛla.»
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: La, sẽn yaa m ba Soaamb n deng yeelã yĩnga, a kiime, t’a Laab rɩk-a, n tɩ maneg n dʋge.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: Rẽ wã, sɩlem-bag-bage, yaa sɩlem-kẽkdga.
title: 17 M ba Laabo kibare

text: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba Kãoongo.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: We-rũmsã fãa, wa n tigma taaba, n yiis noor n yeele :
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Ned ning fãa sẽn wɩd a to, bɩ weeogã kʋ-a.»
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, b yãka m ba Soaamba, t’a lʋɩ b taoore, n gese, tɩ rũmsã fãa tũ noorã.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Dẽ poore, m ba Soaamb baoo ki ne bʋdb koore, n tɩ be sor noor pĩig zugu, n bʋtẽ.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, we-rũng fãa sẽn loogd n pʋʋs m ba Soaamba, a yet-a lame :
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Mam me, wa n maanda bilf-bilf ka, n gũud saaga.»
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, a soab sã n ta taoore, a yetame :
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Yaa tɩ d ra wɩd d taaba yĩnga, la a maand woto bɩ, sã n ka rẽ, ãnda n tõe n bʋd pĩig zug n paam ki ?»
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: A soab sã n yeel woto, a rokdame n lʋɩ n ki, tɩ m ba Soaamb kẽng n tɩ rɩk-a, n kuil n tɩ maneg n rɩ ne a paga.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Sẽn beẽ n beẽ, m ba Kãoong wa n wʋma kibarã, t’a bao kaam ne rʋko, n tʋk n dɩk sore, n teesd m ba Soaamb sẽn beẽ wã sẽnẽ.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: A sẽn wa n ta m ba Soaamb zĩigẽ wã, a pʋʋs-a lame.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Soaamb sok-a lame:
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Yaa noog ne rʋko?»
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, m ba Kãoong leok-a lame :
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Mam tʋka kaam ne rʋko, n dabd n na n tɩ pãnem m zugu.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Tɩ m ba Soaamb yeel-a, tɩ, Wẽnd na sik laafɩ.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: T’a Kãoong le rɩk sore.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: La, a sẽn wa n zãage, m ba Soaamb roogame, n yals n yeele :
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: «Way !
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: B sẽn yeel tɩ d ra wɩd taab yĩng bɩ, sã n ka rẽ, zu-koeemdã, fo zoobdã bee yɛ, sẽn pãnemde?»
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: M ba Soaamb me rokame, n lʋɩ n ki, t’a Kãoong lebg n wa rɩk-a.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba

text: Rẽ wã, yam yɩɩd m zoa sãamda zoodo.
title: 18 M ba Soaamb ne m ba
